PK-1.name: Right superior thoracic artery
origin: 1st part of the axillary artery, above the upper border of pectoralis minor
腋動脈第一段（胸小肌上緣以上）
course: Runs medially and downwards on the chest wall through the 1st and 2nd intercostal spaces
沿胸壁向內下行，經第一、二肋間隙
supply: Intercostal muscles of the 1st–2nd spaces, pectoral muscles and the upper part of the serratus anterior
第一、二肋間肌、胸肌及前鋸肌上部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-2.name: Clavicular branch of right thoraco-acromial artery
origin: Thoraco-acromial trunk, at the upper border of pectoralis minor
胸肩峰動脈幹（胸小肌上緣）
course: Passes up and medially, deep to pectoralis major, towards the clavicle
向內上走，在胸大肌深面往鎖骨
supply: Subclavius, the sternoclavicular joint and the clavicle
鎖骨下肌、胸鎖關節與鎖骨
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-3.name: Right lateral mammary artery
origin: Lateral thoracic artery (sometimes the thoraco-acromial artery)
胸外側動脈（有時來自胸肩峰動脈）
course: Curves round the lateral border of pectoralis major to the breast
繞過胸大肌外側緣到乳房
supply: Lateral part of the mammary gland
乳腺外側部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-4.name: Right medial mammary branch of internal thoracic artery
PK-4.zh: 右內胸動脈內側乳房支
origin: Perforating branches of the internal thoracic artery, 2nd–4th intercostal spaces
內胸動脈穿通支（第二至四肋間隙）
course: Pierce the intercostal space and pectoralis major beside the sternum
在胸骨旁穿過肋間隙與胸大肌
supply: Medial part of the mammary gland
乳腺內側部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-5.name: Right anterior intercostal arteries
origin: Internal thoracic artery (spaces 1–6) and musculophrenic artery (spaces 7–9)
內胸動脈（第一至六間隙）與肌膈動脈（第七至九間隙）
course: Run laterally in the intercostal spaces and anastomose with the posterior intercostal arteries
在肋間隙向外側走，與後肋間動脈吻合
supply: Intercostal muscles and the overlying skin and pectoral muscles
肋間肌及其表面的皮膚與胸肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-6.name: Left superior thoracic artery
origin: 1st part of the axillary artery, above the upper border of pectoralis minor
腋動脈第一段（胸小肌上緣以上）
course: Runs medially and downwards on the chest wall through the 1st and 2nd intercostal spaces
沿胸壁向內下行，經第一、二肋間隙
supply: Intercostal muscles of the 1st–2nd spaces, pectoral muscles and the upper part of the serratus anterior
第一、二肋間肌、胸肌及前鋸肌上部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-7.name: Clavicular branch of left thoraco-acromial artery
origin: Thoraco-acromial trunk, at the upper border of pectoralis minor
胸肩峰動脈幹（胸小肌上緣）
course: Passes up and medially, deep to pectoralis major, towards the clavicle
向內上走，在胸大肌深面往鎖骨
supply: Subclavius, the sternoclavicular joint and the clavicle
鎖骨下肌、胸鎖關節與鎖骨
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-8.name: Left lateral mammary artery
origin: Lateral thoracic artery (sometimes the thoraco-acromial artery)
胸外側動脈（有時來自胸肩峰動脈）
course: Curves round the lateral border of pectoralis major to the breast
繞過胸大肌外側緣到乳房
supply: Lateral part of the mammary gland
乳腺外側部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-9.name: Left medial mammary branch of internal thoracic artery
PK-9.zh: 左內胸動脈內側乳房支
origin: Perforating branches of the internal thoracic artery, 2nd–4th intercostal spaces
內胸動脈穿通支（第二至四肋間隙）
course: Pierce the intercostal space and pectoralis major beside the sternum
在胸骨旁穿過肋間隙與胸大肌
supply: Medial part of the mammary gland
乳腺內側部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-10.name: Left anterior intercostal arteries
origin: Internal thoracic artery (spaces 1–6) and musculophrenic artery (spaces 7–9)
內胸動脈（第一至六間隙）與肌膈動脈（第七至九間隙）
course: Run laterally in the intercostal spaces and anastomose with the posterior intercostal arteries
在肋間隙向外側走，與後肋間動脈吻合
supply: Intercostal muscles and the overlying skin and pectoral muscles
肋間肌及其表面的皮膚與胸肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-11.name: Right phrenic nerve
origin: Ventral rami of C3–C5 (mainly C4), cervical plexus
第三至第五頸神經前支（以 C4 為主），頸神經叢
course: Descends on the front of scalenus anterior, passes between the subclavian artery and vein, then runs on the fibrous pericardium (with the pericardiophrenic vessels) to the diaphragm
沿前斜角肌前面下行，經鎖骨下動脈與鎖骨下靜脈之間，再與心包膈血管一起沿纖維心包到橫膈
supply: Motor to the diaphragm; sensory to the pleura, pericardium and peritoneum over the diaphragm
支配橫膈運動；感覺分布於橫膈的胸膜、心包與腹膜
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-12.name: Right pericardiophrenic artery
origin: Internal thoracic artery
內胸動脈
course: Descends with the phrenic nerve between the fibrous pericardium and the mediastinal pleura to the diaphragm
與膈神經一起在纖維心包與縱隔胸膜之間下行到橫膈
supply: Pericardium, pleura and the upper surface of the diaphragm
心包、胸膜與橫膈上面
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-13.name: Right pericardiophrenic vein
origin: Internal thoracic vein
內胸靜脈
course: Descends with the phrenic nerve between the fibrous pericardium and the mediastinal pleura to the diaphragm
與膈神經一起在纖維心包與縱隔胸膜之間下行到橫膈
supply: Pericardium, pleura and the upper surface of the diaphragm
心包、胸膜與橫膈上面
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-14.name: Right recurrent laryngeal nerve
origin: Vagus nerve (at the level of the right subclavian artery)
迷走神經（在右鎖骨下動脈高度）
course: Hooks round the right subclavian artery and ascends in the groove between the trachea and oesophagus to the larynx
繞過右鎖骨下動脈，在氣管與食道之間的溝內上行到喉
supply: Motor to all intrinsic laryngeal muscles except cricothyroid; sensory below the vocal folds
支配除環甲肌以外的所有喉內肌；聲帶以下黏膜感覺
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-15.name: Right greater splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglia T5–T9
胸交感幹第五至第九胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the coeliac ganglion
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於腹腔神經節
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-16.name: Right lesser splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglia T10–T11
胸交感幹第十至第十一胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the aorticorenal ganglion
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於主動脈腎神經節
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-17.name: Right least splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglion T12
胸交感幹第十二胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the renal plexus (renal ganglion)
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於腎神經叢（腎神經節）
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-18.name: Right celiac ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the coeliac trunk
位於腹腔動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-19.name: Right aorticorenal ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the renal artery
位於腎動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-20.name: Right superior mesenteric ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the superior mesenteric artery
位於腸繫膜上動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-21.name: Right renal ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the renal artery near the renal hilum
位於腎動脈靠近腎門處起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-22.name: Left phrenic nerve
origin: Ventral rami of C3–C5 (mainly C4), cervical plexus
第三至第五頸神經前支（以 C4 為主），頸神經叢
course: Descends on the front of scalenus anterior, passes between the subclavian artery and vein, then runs on the fibrous pericardium (with the pericardiophrenic vessels) to the diaphragm
沿前斜角肌前面下行，經鎖骨下動脈與鎖骨下靜脈之間，再與心包膈血管一起沿纖維心包到橫膈
supply: Motor to the diaphragm; sensory to the pleura, pericardium and peritoneum over the diaphragm
支配橫膈運動；感覺分布於橫膈的胸膜、心包與腹膜
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-23.name: Left pericardiophrenic artery
origin: Internal thoracic artery
內胸動脈
course: Descends with the phrenic nerve between the fibrous pericardium and the mediastinal pleura to the diaphragm
與膈神經一起在纖維心包與縱隔胸膜之間下行到橫膈
supply: Pericardium, pleura and the upper surface of the diaphragm
心包、胸膜與橫膈上面
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-24.name: Left pericardiophrenic vein
origin: Internal thoracic vein
內胸靜脈
course: Descends with the phrenic nerve between the fibrous pericardium and the mediastinal pleura to the diaphragm
與膈神經一起在纖維心包與縱隔胸膜之間下行到橫膈
supply: Pericardium, pleura and the upper surface of the diaphragm
心包、胸膜與橫膈上面
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-25.name: Left recurrent laryngeal nerve
origin: Vagus nerve (at the aortic arch, beside the ligamentum arteriosum)
迷走神經（在主動脈弓、動脈韌帶旁）
course: Hooks round the aortic arch and ascends in the groove between the trachea and oesophagus to the larynx
繞過主動脈弓，在氣管與食道之間的溝內上行到喉
supply: Motor to all intrinsic laryngeal muscles except cricothyroid; sensory below the vocal folds
支配除環甲肌以外的所有喉內肌；聲帶以下黏膜感覺
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-26.name: Left greater splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglia T5–T9
胸交感幹第五至第九胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the coeliac ganglion
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於腹腔神經節
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-27.name: Left lesser splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglia T10–T11
胸交感幹第十至第十一胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the aorticorenal ganglion
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於主動脈腎神經節
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-28.name: Left least splanchnic nerve
origin: Thoracic sympathetic trunk, ganglion T12
胸交感幹第十二胸節
course: Runs down the side of the vertebral bodies, pierces the crus of the diaphragm and ends in the renal plexus (renal ganglion)
沿椎體側面下行，穿過橫膈腳，終於腎神經叢（腎神經節）
supply: Preganglionic sympathetic fibres to the abdominal viscera
腹腔內臟的交感神經節前纖維
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-29.name: Left celiac ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the coeliac trunk
位於腹腔動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-30.name: Left aorticorenal ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the renal artery
位於腎動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-31.name: Left superior mesenteric ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the superior mesenteric artery
位於腸繫膜上動脈起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-32.name: Left renal ganglion
origin: Prevertebral sympathetic ganglion on the aorta
主動脈旁的椎前交感神經節
course: Lies at the origin of the renal artery near the renal hilum
位於腎動脈靠近腎門處起始處
supply: Relay for splanchnic nerve fibres to the abdominal viscera
內臟神經纖維換元後分布到腹腔內臟
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-33.name: Anterior vagal trunk
origin: Left vagus nerve, mainly, after the oesophageal plexus
主要來自左側迷走神經，經食道神經叢重組
course: Runs on the front of the oesophagus through the oesophageal hiatus to the stomach
沿食道前面下行，經食道裂孔到胃
supply: Stomach, liver and biliary tract (anterior gastric and hepatic branches)
胃、肝與膽道（前胃支與肝支）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-34.name: Posterior vagal trunk
origin: Right vagus nerve, mainly, after the oesophageal plexus
主要來自右側迷走神經，經食道神經叢重組
course: Runs on the back of the oesophagus through the oesophageal hiatus to the abdomen
沿食道後面下行，經食道裂孔入腹腔
supply: Stomach (posterior gastric branches) and the coeliac plexus (coeliac branches)
胃（後胃支）與腹腔神經叢（腹腔支）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-35.name: Esophageal plexus
origin: Vagus nerves (both) and sympathetic fibres from the thoracic trunk
左右迷走神經與胸交感幹的交感纖維
course: A network wound round the lower oesophagus; it re-forms into the anterior and posterior vagal trunks
纏繞食道下段的網狀神經叢，再組成迷走神經前幹與後幹
supply: Oesophagus (smooth-muscle motility and secretion)
食道（平滑肌蠕動與分泌）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.): ch. 3 Thorax, ch. 4 Abdomen, ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-36.name: Right lateral cord of brachial plexus
origin: Anterior divisions of the upper and middle trunks (C5–C7)
上幹與中幹的前股（C5–C7）
course: Lies lateral to the axillary artery behind pectoralis minor; gives the lateral pectoral nerve, the musculocutaneous nerve and the lateral root of the median nerve
在胸小肌深面、腋動脈外側；發出外側胸神經、肌皮神經與正中神經外側根
supply: Flexor muscles of the arm (through the musculocutaneous nerve) and the lateral part of the median nerve territory
臂前群屈肌（經肌皮神經）與正中神經外側部分的支配範圍
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-37.name: Right lateral root of median nerve
origin: Lateral cord (C6–C7)
外側束（C6–C7）
course: Crosses in front of the axillary artery to meet the medial root
越過腋動脈前方，與內側根會合
supply: Forms the median nerve with the medial root
與內側根合成正中神經
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-38.name: Right medial cord of brachial plexus
origin: Anterior division of the lower trunk (C8–T1)
下幹前股（C8–T1）
course: Lies medial to the axillary artery; gives the medial pectoral nerve, the medial brachial and antebrachial cutaneous nerves, the ulnar nerve and the medial root of the median nerve
位於腋動脈內側；發出內側胸神經、臂內側與前臂內側皮神經、尺神經與正中神經內側根
supply: Medial forearm and hand muscles (through the ulnar nerve) and medial arm skin
前臂與手內側肌群（經尺神經）及臂內側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-39.name: Right medial root of median nerve
origin: Medial cord (C8–T1)
內側束（C8–T1）
course: Crosses in front of the axillary artery to meet the lateral root
越過腋動脈前方，與外側根會合
supply: Forms the median nerve with the lateral root
與外側根合成正中神經
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-40.name: Right intercostobrachial nerve
origin: Lateral cutaneous branch of the 2nd intercostal nerve (T2)
第二肋間神經（T2）的外側皮支
course: Pierces the 2nd intercostal space in the mid-axillary line, crosses the axilla and joins the medial brachial cutaneous nerve
在腋中線穿出第二肋間隙，越過腋窩並與臂內側皮神經相連
supply: Skin of the axilla and the medial upper arm
腋窩與上臂內側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-41.name: Right recurrent branch of median nerve
origin: Median nerve, at the distal border of the flexor retinaculum
正中神經，位於屈肌支持帶遠側緣
course: Curls laterally and upwards over the flexor pollicis brevis into the thenar muscles
向外側、向上彎，越過屈拇短肌進入魚際肌
supply: Abductor pollicis brevis, flexor pollicis brevis (superficial head) and opponens pollicis
拇短展肌、屈拇短肌（淺頭）與拇對掌肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-42.name: Right posterior circumflex humeral vein
origin: Axillary vein
腋靜脈
course: Accompanies the posterior circumflex humeral artery through the quadrangular space, behind the surgical neck of the humerus
伴隨旋肱後動脈經四邊孔，繞肱骨外科頸後方
supply: Drains the deltoid, teres minor and the shoulder joint
回收三角肌、小圓肌與肩關節的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-43.name: Right posterior interosseous artery
origin: Common interosseous artery (a branch of the ulnar artery)
總骨間動脈（尺動脈的分支）
course: Passes backwards over the upper border of the interosseous membrane and descends between the superficial and deep extensor muscles
越過骨間膜上緣向後，在淺、深伸肌之間下行
supply: Extensor muscles of the forearm; anastomoses with the dorsal carpal network
前臂伸肌群；與腕背網吻合
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-44.name: Right superficial palmar branch of radial artery
origin: Radial artery, just before it turns onto the back of the wrist
橈動脈，在轉到腕背之前
course: Passes through or over the thenar muscles to join the ulnar artery in the superficial palmar arch
穿過或越過魚際肌，與尺動脈在掌淺弓會合
supply: Thenar eminence; completes the superficial palmar arch
魚際隆起；補足掌淺弓
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-45.name: Right deep palmar branch of ulnar artery
origin: Ulnar artery, beside the pisiform
尺動脈，豆狀骨旁
course: Passes between abductor digiti minimi and flexor digiti minimi brevis to the palm and joins the radial artery in the deep palmar arch
穿過小指展肌與小指屈肌之間入掌，與橈動脈在掌深弓會合
supply: Hypothenar muscles; completes the deep palmar arch
小魚際肌；補足掌深弓
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-46.name: Left lateral cord of brachial plexus
origin: Anterior divisions of the upper and middle trunks (C5–C7)
上幹與中幹的前股（C5–C7）
course: Lies lateral to the axillary artery behind pectoralis minor; gives the lateral pectoral nerve, the musculocutaneous nerve and the lateral root of the median nerve
在胸小肌深面、腋動脈外側；發出外側胸神經、肌皮神經與正中神經外側根
supply: Flexor muscles of the arm (through the musculocutaneous nerve) and the lateral part of the median nerve territory
臂前群屈肌（經肌皮神經）與正中神經外側部分的支配範圍
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-47.name: Left lateral root of median nerve
origin: Lateral cord (C6–C7)
外側束（C6–C7）
course: Crosses in front of the axillary artery to meet the medial root
越過腋動脈前方，與內側根會合
supply: Forms the median nerve with the medial root
與內側根合成正中神經
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-48.name: Left medial cord of brachial plexus
origin: Anterior division of the lower trunk (C8–T1)
下幹前股（C8–T1）
course: Lies medial to the axillary artery; gives the medial pectoral nerve, the medial brachial and antebrachial cutaneous nerves, the ulnar nerve and the medial root of the median nerve
位於腋動脈內側；發出內側胸神經、臂內側與前臂內側皮神經、尺神經與正中神經內側根
supply: Medial forearm and hand muscles (through the ulnar nerve) and medial arm skin
前臂與手內側肌群（經尺神經）及臂內側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-49.name: Left medial root of median nerve
origin: Medial cord (C8–T1)
內側束（C8–T1）
course: Crosses in front of the axillary artery to meet the lateral root
越過腋動脈前方，與外側根會合
supply: Forms the median nerve with the lateral root
與外側根合成正中神經
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-50.name: Left intercostobrachial nerve
origin: Lateral cutaneous branch of the 2nd intercostal nerve (T2)
第二肋間神經（T2）的外側皮支
course: Pierces the 2nd intercostal space in the mid-axillary line, crosses the axilla and joins the medial brachial cutaneous nerve
在腋中線穿出第二肋間隙，越過腋窩並與臂內側皮神經相連
supply: Skin of the axilla and the medial upper arm
腋窩與上臂內側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-51.name: Left recurrent branch of median nerve
origin: Median nerve, at the distal border of the flexor retinaculum
正中神經，位於屈肌支持帶遠側緣
course: Curls laterally and upwards over the flexor pollicis brevis into the thenar muscles
向外側、向上彎，越過屈拇短肌進入魚際肌
supply: Abductor pollicis brevis, flexor pollicis brevis (superficial head) and opponens pollicis
拇短展肌、屈拇短肌（淺頭）與拇對掌肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-52.name: Left posterior circumflex humeral vein
origin: Axillary vein
腋靜脈
course: Accompanies the posterior circumflex humeral artery through the quadrangular space, behind the surgical neck of the humerus
伴隨旋肱後動脈經四邊孔，繞肱骨外科頸後方
supply: Drains the deltoid, teres minor and the shoulder joint
回收三角肌、小圓肌與肩關節的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-53.name: Left posterior interosseous artery
origin: Common interosseous artery (a branch of the ulnar artery)
總骨間動脈（尺動脈的分支）
course: Passes backwards over the upper border of the interosseous membrane and descends between the superficial and deep extensor muscles
越過骨間膜上緣向後，在淺、深伸肌之間下行
supply: Extensor muscles of the forearm; anastomoses with the dorsal carpal network
前臂伸肌群；與腕背網吻合
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-54.name: Left superficial palmar branch of radial artery
origin: Radial artery, just before it turns onto the back of the wrist
橈動脈，在轉到腕背之前
course: Passes through or over the thenar muscles to join the ulnar artery in the superficial palmar arch
穿過或越過魚際肌，與尺動脈在掌淺弓會合
supply: Thenar eminence; completes the superficial palmar arch
魚際隆起；補足掌淺弓
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-55.name: Left deep palmar branch of ulnar artery
origin: Ulnar artery, beside the pisiform
尺動脈，豆狀骨旁
course: Passes between abductor digiti minimi and flexor digiti minimi brevis to the palm and joins the radial artery in the deep palmar arch
穿過小指展肌與小指屈肌之間入掌，與橈動脈在掌深弓會合
supply: Hypothenar muscles; completes the deep palmar arch
小魚際肌；補足掌深弓
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb

PK-56.name: Right lateral brachial vein
origin: Radial and ulnar veins, at the elbow (with the medial brachial vein)
橈靜脈與尺靜脈，在肘部（與內側肱靜脈並行）
course: Runs with the brachial artery on its lateral side and joins the axillary vein (the basilic vein usually ends in the medial brachial vein or the axillary vein)
與肱動脈並行於其外側，注入腋靜脈（貴要靜脈通常注入內側肱靜脈或腋靜脈）
supply: Drains the muscles and bone of the arm and the elbow joint, together with the medial brachial vein
與內側肱靜脈共同回收上臂肌肉、骨與肘關節的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-57.name: Right anterior interosseous vein
origin: Deep veins of the anterior forearm
前臂前側深靜脈
course: Runs with the anterior interosseous artery and ends in the ulnar vein
與前骨間動脈並行，注入尺靜脈
supply: Drains the deep muscles and bones of the forearm
回收前臂深層肌肉與骨的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-58.name: Right posterior interosseous vein
origin: Deep veins of the posterior forearm
前臂後側深靜脈
course: Runs with the posterior interosseous artery and ends in the ulnar vein
與後骨間動脈並行，注入尺靜脈
supply: Drains the deep muscles and bones of the forearm
回收前臂深層肌肉與骨的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-59.name: Right thoracoepigastric vein
origin: Lateral thoracic vein (a tributary of the axillary vein) above; superficial epigastric vein (a tributary of the great saphenous vein) below
上方為胸外側靜脈（腋靜脈屬支），下方為腹壁淺靜脈（大隱靜脈屬支）
course: Runs under the skin along the side of the chest and abdomen from the axilla to the groin, linking the superior and inferior vena cava systems
沿胸腹側壁皮下由腋窩下行到鼠蹊部，連接上、下腔靜脈系統
supply: Drains the skin and subcutaneous tissue of the lateral trunk; enlarges as a collateral route when a vena cava is blocked
回收側軀幹皮膚與皮下組織；腔靜脈阻塞時成為側枝循環
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-60.name: Left lateral brachial vein
origin: Radial and ulnar veins, at the elbow (with the medial brachial vein)
橈靜脈與尺靜脈，在肘部（與內側肱靜脈並行）
course: Runs with the brachial artery on its lateral side and joins the axillary vein (the basilic vein usually ends in the medial brachial vein or the axillary vein)
與肱動脈並行於其外側，注入腋靜脈（貴要靜脈通常注入內側肱靜脈或腋靜脈）
supply: Drains the muscles and bone of the arm and the elbow joint, together with the medial brachial vein
與內側肱靜脈共同回收上臂肌肉、骨與肘關節的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-61.name: Left anterior interosseous vein
origin: Deep veins of the anterior forearm
前臂前側深靜脈
course: Runs with the anterior interosseous artery and ends in the ulnar vein
與前骨間動脈並行，注入尺靜脈
supply: Drains the deep muscles and bones of the forearm
回收前臂深層肌肉與骨的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-62.name: Left posterior interosseous vein
origin: Deep veins of the posterior forearm
前臂後側深靜脈
course: Runs with the posterior interosseous artery and ends in the ulnar vein
與後骨間動脈並行，注入尺靜脈
supply: Drains the deep muscles and bones of the forearm
回收前臂深層肌肉與骨的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-63.name: Left thoracoepigastric vein
origin: Lateral thoracic vein (a tributary of the axillary vein) above; superficial epigastric vein (a tributary of the great saphenous vein) below
上方為胸外側靜脈（腋靜脈屬支），下方為腹壁淺靜脈（大隱靜脈屬支）
course: Runs under the skin along the side of the chest and abdomen from the axilla to the groin, linking the superior and inferior vena cava systems
沿胸腹側壁皮下由腋窩下行到鼠蹊部，連接上、下腔靜脈系統
supply: Drains the skin and subcutaneous tissue of the lateral trunk; enlarges as a collateral route when a vena cava is blocked
回收側軀幹皮膚與皮下組織；腔靜脈阻塞時成為側枝循環
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 7 Upper Limb and ch. 4 Abdomen

PK-64.name: Right deep femoral artery
origin: Femoral artery, 3–5 cm below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方 3–5 公分）
course: Passes backwards and laterally behind the femoral vessels, deep to adductor longus, and ends as the 4th perforating artery
向後外側行經股血管後方、內收長肌深面，終止為第四穿通動脈
supply: Main blood supply of the thigh muscles and the femur
大腿肌肉與股骨的主要血液供應
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-65.name: Right perforating branch of deep femoral artery
origin: Deep femoral artery (three perforating branches, one for each of the upper three adductor attachments)
股深動脈（三條穿通支）
course: Pierce adductor brevis/magnus close to the linea aspera and reach the posterior compartment
貼近股骨粗線穿過內收短肌與內收大肌，到達大腿後區
supply: Hamstrings, adductor magnus and the femoral shaft (they anastomose with each other and with the gluteal and popliteal arteries)
膕繩肌、內收大肌與股骨幹（彼此及與臀動脈、膕動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-66.name: Right medial circumflex femoral artery
origin: Deep femoral artery (sometimes the femoral artery)
股深動脈（有時來自股動脈）
course: Winds backwards round the medial side of the femoral neck between pectineus and iliopsoas, then passes above quadratus femoris to the trochanteric fossa
繞股骨頸內側向後，經恥骨肌與髂腰肌之間，再越過方形股肌上緣到轉子窩
supply: Femoral head and neck (retinacular arteries) and the adjacent muscles
股骨頭、頸（支持帶動脈）與鄰近肌肉
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-67.name: Right ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
origin: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
旋股外側動脈
course: Ascends laterally beneath sartorius and rectus femoris, towards the anterior superior iliac spine
在縫匠肌與股直肌深面向外上走，朝髂前上棘
supply: Tensor fasciae latae and the muscles round the hip (anastomoses with the superior gluteal artery)
闊筋膜張肌與髖周肌肉（與臀上動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-68.name: Right transverse branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
origin: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
旋股外側動脈
course: Runs laterally through vastus lateralis and winds round the femur below the greater trochanter
向外側穿過股外側肌，繞過大轉子下方的股骨
supply: Vastus lateralis and the cruciate anastomosis of the thigh
股外側肌與大腿的十字吻合
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-69.name: Right superficial circumflex iliac artery
origin: Femoral artery, 1–2 cm below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方 1–2 公分）
course: Runs laterally in the superficial fascia, parallel to and below the inguinal ligament, towards the anterior superior iliac spine
在淺筋膜內向外、與腹股溝韌帶平行並位於其下方，朝髂前上棘
supply: Skin and superficial fascia of the groin and lower abdominal wall
腹股溝與下腹壁的皮膚與淺筋膜
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-70.name: Right superficial external pudendal artery
origin: Femoral artery, below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方）
course: Passes medially across the spermatic cord (or round ligament) to the skin of the scrotum or labium majus
向內側越過精索（或子宮圓韌帶），到陰囊或大陰唇皮膚
supply: Skin of the lower abdomen, penis and scrotum (labium majus)
下腹、陰莖與陰囊（大陰唇）皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-71.name: Right deep external pudendal artery
origin: Femoral artery, below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方）
course: Passes medially deep to the great saphenous vein and across adductor longus to the skin of the perineum
向內側行經大隱靜脈深面、越過內收長肌，到會陰皮膚
supply: Skin of the scrotum (labium majus) and perineum
陰囊（大陰唇）與會陰皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-72.name: Right articular branch of descending genicular artery
origin: Descending genicular artery, in the adductor canal
膝降動脈（內收肌管內）
course: Passes down in front of the medial side of the knee towards the patella
沿膝內側前方下行，朝髕骨
supply: Knee joint (anterior part) and the patellar anastomosis
膝關節前部與髕網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-73.name: Right saphenous branch of descending genicular artery
origin: Descending genicular artery, in the adductor canal
膝降動脈（內收肌管內）
course: Pierces the fascia and runs with the saphenous nerve down the medial side of the leg
穿出筋膜，與隱神經一起沿小腿內側下行
supply: Skin of the medial knee and upper leg
膝內側與小腿上部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-74.name: Right anterior lateral malleolar artery
origin: Anterior tibial artery, just above the ankle
脛前動脈（踝關節上方）
course: Passes laterally deep to the tendons of extensor digitorum longus and fibularis tertius to the lateral malleolus
行經伸趾長肌與第三腓骨肌腱深面，向外到外踝
supply: Ankle joint and the lateral malleolar network
踝關節與外踝網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-75.name: Right anterior medial malleolar artery
origin: Anterior tibial artery, just above the ankle
脛前動脈（踝關節上方）
course: Passes medially deep to the tendons of tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus to the medial malleolus
行經脛前肌與伸拇長肌腱深面，向內到內踝
supply: Ankle joint and the medial malleolar network
踝關節與內踝網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-76.name: Right fibular artery
origin: Posterior tibial artery, 2–3 cm below the lower border of popliteus
脛後動脈（膕肌下緣下方 2–3 公分）
course: Descends along the medial side of the fibula (under flexor hallucis longus) to the lateral side of the calcaneus
沿腓骨內側（屈拇長肌深面）下行，到跟骨外側
supply: Lateral and posterior compartments of the leg, the fibula and the lateral side of the heel
小腿外側與後區、腓骨與足跟外側
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-77.name: Right circumflex fibular artery
origin: Posterior tibial artery, near its origin (sometimes the anterior tibial artery)
脛後動脈起始處附近（有時來自脛前動脈）
course: Winds round the neck of the fibula under soleus and joins the genicular anastomosis
在比目魚肌深面繞過腓骨頸，與膝關節網吻合
supply: Head and neck of the fibula and the proximal tibiofibular joint
腓骨頭、頸與脛腓近側關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-78.name: Right lateral plantar vein
origin: Plantar venous arch
足底靜脈弓
course: Accompanies the lateral plantar artery and nerve and joins the medial plantar vein behind the medial malleolus to form the posterior tibial vein
伴隨足底外側動脈與神經，在內踝後方與足底內側靜脈合成脛後靜脈
supply: Drains the lateral plantar region and the plantar muscles
回收足底外側與足底肌肉的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-79.name: Right superior gluteal artery
origin: Posterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈後幹
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen above piriformis and divides into superficial and deep branches
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌上緣出骨盆，分為淺支與深支
supply: Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus and tensor fasciae latae
臀大肌、臀中肌、臀小肌與闊筋膜張肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-80.name: Right superficial branch of superior gluteal artery
origin: Superior gluteal artery
臀上動脈
course: Enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus
進入臀大肌深面
supply: Gluteus maximus
臀大肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-81.name: Right deep branch of superior gluteal artery
origin: Superior gluteal artery
臀上動脈
course: Runs between gluteus medius and minimus (with the superior gluteal nerve) towards the greater trochanter
在臀中肌與臀小肌之間（與臀上神經一起）朝大轉子
supply: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and the hip joint
臀中肌、臀小肌與髖關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-82.name: Right inferior gluteal artery
origin: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈前幹
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis and descends into gluteus maximus with the sciatic nerve
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，與坐骨神經一起下行進入臀大肌
supply: Gluteus maximus, the upper hamstrings and the sciatic nerve (companion artery)
臀大肌、膕繩肌上部與坐骨神經（伴行動脈）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-83.name: Right internal pudendal artery
origin: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈前幹
course: Leaves through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, curls round the ischial spine and re-enters the pelvis through the lesser sciatic foramen to the pudendal canal
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，繞坐骨棘後經坐骨小孔回到會陰，走入陰部管
supply: Perineum and external genitalia (with the pudendal nerve)
會陰與外生殖器（與陰部神經伴行）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-84.name: Right inferior gluteal nerve
origin: Sacral plexus (L5–S2)
薦神經叢（L5–S2）
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis and enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，進入臀大肌深面
supply: Gluteus maximus
臀大肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-85.name: Right nerve to obturator internus
origin: Sacral plexus (L5–S1)
薦神經叢（L5–S1）
course: Leaves through the greater sciatic foramen, crosses the ischial spine and re-enters the pelvis through the lesser sciatic foramen to obturator internus; gives a branch to gemellus superior
經坐骨大孔出骨盆，越過坐骨棘，再經坐骨小孔回到閉孔內肌；並分支至上孖肌
supply: Obturator internus and gemellus superior
閉孔內肌與上孖肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-86.name: Right nerve to vastus medialis
origin: Femoral nerve (posterior division)
股神經（後股）
course: Runs with the saphenous nerve in the adductor canal and enters vastus medialis (it gives off the articular branch to the knee)
與隱神經一起走在內收肌管內，進入股內側肌（並發出膝關節支）
supply: Vastus medialis and the knee joint
股內側肌與膝關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-87.name: Right lateral sural cutaneous nerve
origin: Common fibular nerve, in the popliteal fossa
總腓神經（膕窩內）
course: Pierces the deep fascia and descends over the lateral head of gastrocnemius; often gives the sural communicating branch
穿出深筋膜，沿腓腸肌外側頭表面下行；常發出腓腸交通支
supply: Skin of the lateral side of the leg
小腿外側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-88.name: Right lateral dorsal cutaneous nerve
origin: Sural nerve (terminal part)
腓腸神經（末段）
course: Passes behind and below the lateral malleolus and runs along the lateral border of the foot
繞過外踝後下方，沿足外側緣前行
supply: Skin of the lateral foot and the little toe
足外側與小趾皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-89.name: Right medial branch of deep fibular nerve
origin: Deep fibular nerve, at the ankle
腓深神經（踝部）
course: Runs on the dorsum of the foot lateral to the dorsalis pedis artery to the cleft between the 1st and 2nd toes
沿足背走在足背動脈外側，到第一、二趾之間
supply: Skin of the adjacent sides of the great and second toes
拇趾與第二趾相對面的皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-90.name: Right lateral branch of deep fibular nerve
origin: Deep fibular nerve, at the ankle
腓深神經（踝部）
course: Passes laterally under extensor digitorum longus and brevis tendons
向外側走，經伸趾長肌與伸趾短肌腱深面
supply: Extensor digitorum brevis and extensor hallucis brevis, and the tarsal and metatarsophalangeal joints
伸趾短肌與伸拇短肌，及跗骨、蹠趾關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-91.name: Left deep femoral artery
origin: Femoral artery, 3–5 cm below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方 3–5 公分）
course: Passes backwards and laterally behind the femoral vessels, deep to adductor longus, and ends as the 4th perforating artery
向後外側行經股血管後方、內收長肌深面，終止為第四穿通動脈
supply: Main blood supply of the thigh muscles and the femur
大腿肌肉與股骨的主要血液供應
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-92.name: Left perforating branch of deep femoral artery
origin: Deep femoral artery (three perforating branches, one for each of the upper three adductor attachments)
股深動脈（三條穿通支）
course: Pierce adductor brevis/magnus close to the linea aspera and reach the posterior compartment
貼近股骨粗線穿過內收短肌與內收大肌，到達大腿後區
supply: Hamstrings, adductor magnus and the femoral shaft (they anastomose with each other and with the gluteal and popliteal arteries)
膕繩肌、內收大肌與股骨幹（彼此及與臀動脈、膕動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-93.name: Left medial circumflex femoral artery
origin: Deep femoral artery (sometimes the femoral artery)
股深動脈（有時來自股動脈）
course: Winds backwards round the medial side of the femoral neck between pectineus and iliopsoas, then passes above quadratus femoris to the trochanteric fossa
繞股骨頸內側向後，經恥骨肌與髂腰肌之間，再越過方形股肌上緣到轉子窩
supply: Femoral head and neck (retinacular arteries) and the adjacent muscles
股骨頭、頸（支持帶動脈）與鄰近肌肉
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-94.name: Left ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
origin: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
旋股外側動脈
course: Ascends laterally beneath sartorius and rectus femoris, towards the anterior superior iliac spine
在縫匠肌與股直肌深面向外上走，朝髂前上棘
supply: Tensor fasciae latae and the muscles round the hip (anastomoses with the superior gluteal artery)
闊筋膜張肌與髖周肌肉（與臀上動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-95.name: Left transverse branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery
origin: Lateral circumflex femoral artery
旋股外側動脈
course: Runs laterally through vastus lateralis and winds round the femur below the greater trochanter
向外側穿過股外側肌，繞過大轉子下方的股骨
supply: Vastus lateralis and the cruciate anastomosis of the thigh
股外側肌與大腿的十字吻合
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-96.name: Left superficial circumflex iliac artery
origin: Femoral artery, 1–2 cm below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方 1–2 公分）
course: Runs laterally in the superficial fascia, parallel to and below the inguinal ligament, towards the anterior superior iliac spine
在淺筋膜內向外、與腹股溝韌帶平行並位於其下方，朝髂前上棘
supply: Skin and superficial fascia of the groin and lower abdominal wall
腹股溝與下腹壁的皮膚與淺筋膜
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-97.name: Left superficial external pudendal artery
origin: Femoral artery, below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方）
course: Passes medially across the spermatic cord (or round ligament) to the skin of the scrotum or labium majus
向內側越過精索（或子宮圓韌帶），到陰囊或大陰唇皮膚
supply: Skin of the lower abdomen, penis and scrotum (labium majus)
下腹、陰莖與陰囊（大陰唇）皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-98.name: Left deep external pudendal artery
origin: Femoral artery, below the inguinal ligament
股動脈（腹股溝韌帶下方）
course: Passes medially deep to the great saphenous vein and across adductor longus to the skin of the perineum
向內側行經大隱靜脈深面、越過內收長肌，到會陰皮膚
supply: Skin of the scrotum (labium majus) and perineum
陰囊（大陰唇）與會陰皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-99.name: Left articular branch of descending genicular artery
origin: Descending genicular artery, in the adductor canal
膝降動脈（內收肌管內）
course: Passes down in front of the medial side of the knee towards the patella
沿膝內側前方下行，朝髕骨
supply: Knee joint (anterior part) and the patellar anastomosis
膝關節前部與髕網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-100.name: Left saphenous branch of descending genicular artery
origin: Descending genicular artery, in the adductor canal
膝降動脈（內收肌管內）
course: Pierces the fascia and runs with the saphenous nerve down the medial side of the leg
穿出筋膜，與隱神經一起沿小腿內側下行
supply: Skin of the medial knee and upper leg
膝內側與小腿上部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-101.name: Left anterior lateral malleolar artery
origin: Anterior tibial artery, just above the ankle
脛前動脈（踝關節上方）
course: Passes laterally deep to the tendons of extensor digitorum longus and fibularis tertius to the lateral malleolus
行經伸趾長肌與第三腓骨肌腱深面，向外到外踝
supply: Ankle joint and the lateral malleolar network
踝關節與外踝網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-102.name: Left anterior medial malleolar artery
origin: Anterior tibial artery, just above the ankle
脛前動脈（踝關節上方）
course: Passes medially deep to the tendons of tibialis anterior and extensor hallucis longus to the medial malleolus
行經脛前肌與伸拇長肌腱深面，向內到內踝
supply: Ankle joint and the medial malleolar network
踝關節與內踝網
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-103.name: Left fibular artery
origin: Posterior tibial artery, 2–3 cm below the lower border of popliteus
脛後動脈（膕肌下緣下方 2–3 公分）
course: Descends along the medial side of the fibula (under flexor hallucis longus) to the lateral side of the calcaneus
沿腓骨內側（屈拇長肌深面）下行，到跟骨外側
supply: Lateral and posterior compartments of the leg, the fibula and the lateral side of the heel
小腿外側與後區、腓骨與足跟外側
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-104.name: Left circumflex fibular artery
origin: Posterior tibial artery, near its origin (sometimes the anterior tibial artery)
脛後動脈起始處附近（有時來自脛前動脈）
course: Winds round the neck of the fibula under soleus and joins the genicular anastomosis
在比目魚肌深面繞過腓骨頸，與膝關節網吻合
supply: Head and neck of the fibula and the proximal tibiofibular joint
腓骨頭、頸與脛腓近側關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-105.name: Left lateral plantar vein
origin: Plantar venous arch
足底靜脈弓
course: Accompanies the lateral plantar artery and nerve and joins the medial plantar vein behind the medial malleolus to form the posterior tibial vein
伴隨足底外側動脈與神經，在內踝後方與足底內側靜脈合成脛後靜脈
supply: Drains the lateral plantar region and the plantar muscles
回收足底外側與足底肌肉的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-106.name: Left superior gluteal artery
origin: Posterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈後幹
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen above piriformis and divides into superficial and deep branches
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌上緣出骨盆，分為淺支與深支
supply: Gluteus maximus, medius and minimus and tensor fasciae latae
臀大肌、臀中肌、臀小肌與闊筋膜張肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-107.name: Left superficial branch of superior gluteal artery
origin: Superior gluteal artery
臀上動脈
course: Enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus
進入臀大肌深面
supply: Gluteus maximus
臀大肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-108.name: Left deep branch of superior gluteal artery
origin: Superior gluteal artery
臀上動脈
course: Runs between gluteus medius and minimus (with the superior gluteal nerve) towards the greater trochanter
在臀中肌與臀小肌之間（與臀上神經一起）朝大轉子
supply: Gluteus medius, gluteus minimus and the hip joint
臀中肌、臀小肌與髖關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-109.name: Left inferior gluteal artery
origin: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈前幹
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis and descends into gluteus maximus with the sciatic nerve
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，與坐骨神經一起下行進入臀大肌
supply: Gluteus maximus, the upper hamstrings and the sciatic nerve (companion artery)
臀大肌、膕繩肌上部與坐骨神經（伴行動脈）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-110.name: Left internal pudendal artery
origin: Anterior division of the internal iliac artery
髂內動脈前幹
course: Leaves through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis, curls round the ischial spine and re-enters the pelvis through the lesser sciatic foramen to the pudendal canal
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，繞坐骨棘後經坐骨小孔回到會陰，走入陰部管
supply: Perineum and external genitalia (with the pudendal nerve)
會陰與外生殖器（與陰部神經伴行）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-111.name: Left inferior gluteal nerve
origin: Sacral plexus (L5–S2)
薦神經叢（L5–S2）
course: Leaves the pelvis through the greater sciatic foramen below piriformis and enters the deep surface of gluteus maximus
經坐骨大孔、梨狀肌下緣出骨盆，進入臀大肌深面
supply: Gluteus maximus
臀大肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-112.name: Left nerve to obturator internus
origin: Sacral plexus (L5–S1)
薦神經叢（L5–S1）
course: Leaves through the greater sciatic foramen, crosses the ischial spine and re-enters the pelvis through the lesser sciatic foramen to obturator internus; gives a branch to gemellus superior
經坐骨大孔出骨盆，越過坐骨棘，再經坐骨小孔回到閉孔內肌；並分支至上孖肌
supply: Obturator internus and gemellus superior
閉孔內肌與上孖肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-113.name: Left nerve to vastus medialis
origin: Femoral nerve (posterior division)
股神經（後股）
course: Runs with the saphenous nerve in the adductor canal and enters vastus medialis (it gives off the articular branch to the knee)
與隱神經一起走在內收肌管內，進入股內側肌（並發出膝關節支）
supply: Vastus medialis and the knee joint
股內側肌與膝關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-114.name: Left lateral sural cutaneous nerve
origin: Common fibular nerve, in the popliteal fossa
總腓神經（膕窩內）
course: Pierces the deep fascia and descends over the lateral head of gastrocnemius; often gives the sural communicating branch
穿出深筋膜，沿腓腸肌外側頭表面下行；常發出腓腸交通支
supply: Skin of the lateral side of the leg
小腿外側皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-115.name: Left lateral dorsal cutaneous nerve
origin: Sural nerve (terminal part)
腓腸神經（末段）
course: Passes behind and below the lateral malleolus and runs along the lateral border of the foot
繞過外踝後下方，沿足外側緣前行
supply: Skin of the lateral foot and the little toe
足外側與小趾皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-116.name: Left medial branch of deep fibular nerve
origin: Deep fibular nerve, at the ankle
腓深神經（踝部）
course: Runs on the dorsum of the foot lateral to the dorsalis pedis artery to the cleft between the 1st and 2nd toes
沿足背走在足背動脈外側，到第一、二趾之間
supply: Skin of the adjacent sides of the great and second toes
拇趾與第二趾相對面的皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-117.name: Left lateral branch of deep fibular nerve
origin: Deep fibular nerve, at the ankle
腓深神經（踝部）
course: Passes laterally under extensor digitorum longus and brevis tendons
向外側走，經伸趾長肌與伸趾短肌腱深面
supply: Extensor digitorum brevis and extensor hallucis brevis, and the tarsal and metatarsophalangeal joints
伸趾短肌與伸拇短肌，及跗骨、蹠趾關節
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 5 Pelvis and Perineum and ch. 6 Lower Limb

PK-118.name: Thoracic duct
origin: Cisterna chyli at L1–L2, in front of the vertebral bodies
乳糜池（L1–L2，位於椎體前方）
course: Passes through the aortic hiatus, ascends between the aorta and the azygos vein in the posterior mediastinum, crosses to the left at about T5 behind the oesophagus, arches over the left subclavian artery and ends at the left venous angle
經主動脈裂孔，在後縱隔位於主動脈與奇靜脈之間上行，約在 T5 處越到左側（食道後方），弓過左鎖骨下動脈，終止於左靜脈角
supply: Returns lymph from the whole body below the diaphragm and from the left side of the head, neck, thorax and left upper limb to the venous system
收集橫膈以下全身及左側頭頸、胸部與左上肢的淋巴，注入靜脈系統
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-119.name: Right posterior intercostal veins
origin: Azygos vein
奇靜脈
course: Run forwards in the costal groove, above the artery and below the rib, in each intercostal space
在各肋間隙沿肋溝向前走，位於動脈上方、肋骨下緣
supply: Drain the posterior intercostal spaces, the back muscles and the vertebral venous plexuses
回收後肋間隙、背肌與椎靜脈叢的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-120.name: Right supreme intercostal artery
origin: Costocervical trunk (from the 2nd part of the subclavian artery)
肋頸動脈幹（來自鎖骨下動脈第二段）
course: Descends in front of the neck of the 1st and 2nd ribs and gives the 1st and 2nd posterior intercostal arteries
在第一、二肋頸前方下行，發出第一、二後肋間動脈
supply: The first two intercostal spaces and the neighbouring back muscles
第一、二肋間隙與鄰近背肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-121.name: Right superior phrenic artery
origin: Lowest part of the thoracic aorta, just above the diaphragm
胸主動脈最下段（橫膈上方）
course: Runs to the posterior part of the upper surface of the diaphragm
走到橫膈上面後部
supply: Posterior part of the diaphragm (anastomoses with the musculophrenic and pericardiophrenic arteries)
橫膈後部（與肌膈動脈、心包膈動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-122.name: Left posterior intercostal veins
origin: Hemiazygos or accessory hemiazygos vein
半奇靜脈或副半奇靜脈
course: Run forwards in the costal groove, above the artery and below the rib, in each intercostal space
在各肋間隙沿肋溝向前走，位於動脈上方、肋骨下緣
supply: Drain the posterior intercostal spaces, the back muscles and the vertebral venous plexuses
回收後肋間隙、背肌與椎靜脈叢的血液
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-123.name: Left supreme intercostal artery
origin: Costocervical trunk (from the 2nd part of the subclavian artery)
肋頸動脈幹（來自鎖骨下動脈第二段）
course: Descends in front of the neck of the 1st and 2nd ribs and gives the 1st and 2nd posterior intercostal arteries
在第一、二肋頸前方下行，發出第一、二後肋間動脈
supply: The first two intercostal spaces and the neighbouring back muscles
第一、二肋間隙與鄰近背肌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-124.name: Left superior phrenic artery
origin: Lowest part of the thoracic aorta, just above the diaphragm
胸主動脈最下段（橫膈上方）
course: Runs to the posterior part of the upper surface of the diaphragm
走到橫膈上面後部
supply: Posterior part of the diaphragm (anastomoses with the musculophrenic and pericardiophrenic arteries)
橫膈後部（與肌膈動脈、心包膈動脈吻合）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-125.name: Atrioventricular nodal artery
origin: Right coronary artery (in about 80 % of hearts), at the crux where the posterior interventricular and atrioventricular grooves meet
右冠狀動脈（約八成），位於後室間溝與房室溝交會的心十字處
course: Runs up into the interatrial septum to the atrioventricular node, in front of the opening of the coronary sinus
向上進入房間隔，到冠狀竇開口前方的房室結
supply: Atrioventricular node and the start of the atrioventricular bundle
房室結與房室束起始部
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax
PK-125.parent: Posterior interventricular branch of right coronary artery

PK-126.name: Right dorsal ramus of thoracic spinal nerve
origin: Spinal nerves T2–T11, just outside the intervertebral foramen
第二至第十一胸脊神經，在椎間孔外
course: Pass backwards between the transverse processes and divide into medial and lateral branches that supply the deep back muscles
向後穿過橫突之間，分成內側支與外側支，分布到深背肌
supply: Deep (intrinsic) back muscles and the skin of the back
深背肌（固有背肌）與背部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-127.name: Right posterior cutaneous branch of dorsal ramus of thoracic spinal nerve
PK-127.zh: 右胸脊神經後支的後皮支
origin: Medial (upper thoracic) or lateral (lower thoracic) branch of the dorsal ramus
後支的內側支（上胸段）或外側支（下胸段）
course: Pierces trapezius or latissimus dorsi near the midline and runs in the superficial fascia of the back (drawn only as far as the back surface of the muscle)
在中線附近穿過斜方肌或背闊肌，走在背部淺筋膜內（此處只畫到肌肉背面）
supply: Skin of the back along the vertebral column
沿脊柱的背部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-128.name: Left dorsal ramus of thoracic spinal nerve
origin: Spinal nerves T2–T11, just outside the intervertebral foramen
第二至第十一胸脊神經，在椎間孔外
course: Pass backwards between the transverse processes and divide into medial and lateral branches that supply the deep back muscles
向後穿過橫突之間，分成內側支與外側支，分布到深背肌
supply: Deep (intrinsic) back muscles and the skin of the back
深背肌（固有背肌）與背部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-129.name: Left posterior cutaneous branch of dorsal ramus of thoracic spinal nerve
PK-129.zh: 左胸脊神經後支的後皮支
origin: Medial (upper thoracic) or lateral (lower thoracic) branch of the dorsal ramus
後支的內側支（上胸段）或外側支（下胸段）
course: Pierces trapezius or latissimus dorsi near the midline and runs in the superficial fascia of the back (drawn only as far as the back surface of the muscle)
在中線附近穿過斜方肌或背闊肌，走在背部淺筋膜內（此處只畫到肌肉背面）
supply: Skin of the back along the vertebral column
沿脊柱的背部皮膚
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back and ch. 3 Thorax

PK-130.name: Right greater tubercle of humerus
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Lateral, at the upper end of the humerus below the head; carries the supraspinatus, infraspinatus and teres minor attachments
位於肱骨上端、肱骨頭外下方；供棘上肌、棘下肌與小圓肌附著
supply: Insertion of three rotator cuff muscles
三條旋轉肌袖肌肉的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-131.name: Right lesser tubercle of humerus
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Anterior, medial to the greater tubercle; carries the subscapularis tendon
位於前方、大結節內側；供肩胛下肌腱附著
supply: Insertion of subscapularis
肩胛下肌的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-132.name: Right intertubercular groove
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Between the greater and lesser tubercles on the front of the humerus; also called the bicipital groove
位於肱骨前面大、小結節之間；又稱二頭肌溝
supply: Holds the tendon of the long head of biceps brachii
容納肱二頭肌長頭肌腱
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-133.name: Right surgical neck of humerus
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Narrowing just below the tubercles, where fractures are common
結節下方的縮窄處，是常見骨折部位
supply: Axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral vessels wind round it
腋神經與旋肱後血管繞過此處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-134.name: Right radial groove
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: A spiral groove running obliquely on the back of the humeral shaft, from medial above to lateral below
在肱骨幹後面斜行的螺旋溝，由上內側走向下外側
supply: Carries the radial nerve and the deep brachial artery
容納橈神經與肱深動脈
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-135.name: Right medial epicondyle of humerus
origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Prominent bump on the medial side of the lower end of the humerus
肱骨下端內側的明顯隆起
supply: Common flexor origin; the ulnar nerve passes behind it
屈肌總起點；尺神經經其後方
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-136.name: Right coracoid process
origin: On the scapula
肩胛骨
course: Hook-shaped projection from the upper border of the scapula, pointing forwards and laterally
肩胛骨上緣向前外方的鉤狀突起
supply: Origin of coracobrachialis and the short head of biceps; insertion of pectoralis minor
喙肱肌與肱二頭肌短頭的起點；胸小肌的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-137.name: Right suprascapular notch
origin: On the scapula
肩胛骨
course: A notch in the upper border of the scapula, medial to the base of the coracoid process, bridged by the superior transverse scapular ligament
肩胛骨上緣、喙突基部內側的切跡，上方由肩胛上橫韌帶橫跨
supply: The suprascapular nerve passes through it; the suprascapular artery runs above the ligament
肩胛上神經由此通過；肩胛上動脈走在韌帶上方
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-138.name: Right infraglenoid tubercle
origin: On the scapula
肩胛骨
course: Rough area just below the glenoid cavity
關節盂正下方的粗糙面
supply: Origin of the long head of triceps brachii
肱三頭肌長頭的起點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-139.name: Right infraspinous fossa
origin: On the scapula
肩胛骨
course: The large hollow below the spine of the scapula on its back surface
肩胛骨後面、肩胛棘下方的大凹窩
supply: Origin of infraspinatus; the suprascapular vessels and nerve supply it
棘下肌的起點；由肩胛上血管與神經供應
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-140.name: Right styloid process of radius
origin: On the radius
橈骨
course: Pointed lateral projection at the lower end of the radius
橈骨下端外側的尖突
supply: Insertion of brachioradialis; the radial collateral ligament of the wrist attaches here
肱橈肌的止點；腕橈側副韌帶附著於此
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-141.name: Right iliac crest
origin: On the hip bone
髖骨
course: The curved upper border of the ilium, from the anterior to the posterior superior iliac spine
髂骨彎曲的上緣，由髂前上棘延伸到髂後上棘
supply: Attachment of the abdominal wall muscles, latissimus dorsi and the fascia lata
腹壁肌肉、背闊肌與闊筋膜的附著處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-142.name: Right pubic tubercle
origin: On the hip bone
髖骨
course: A small rounded projection on the upper border of the pubis, about 2 cm from the symphysis
恥骨上緣、距恥骨聯合約 2 公分的小圓突
supply: Medial attachment of the inguinal ligament
腹股溝韌帶的內側附著點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-143.name: Right ischial tuberosity
origin: On the hip bone
髖骨
course: Thick roughened lower part of the ischium that bears the weight in sitting
坐骨下方粗糙肥厚、坐姿時承重的部分
supply: Origin of the hamstrings; sacrotuberous ligament attaches here
膕繩肌的起點；薦結節韌帶附著於此
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-144.name: Right spine of ischium
origin: On the hip bone
髖骨
course: Pointed projection from the back of the ischium between the greater and lesser sciatic notches
坐骨後緣、坐骨大切跡與小切跡之間的尖突
supply: Attachment of the sacrospinous ligament; the pudendal nerve and internal pudendal vessels wind round it
薦棘韌帶的附著處；陰部神經與陰部內血管繞過此處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-145.name: Right tibial tuberosity
origin: On the tibia
脛骨
course: Rough elevation on the front of the upper tibia
脛骨上端前面的粗糙隆起
supply: Insertion of the patellar ligament
髕韌帶的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

origin: On the humerus
肱骨

位於肱骨上端、肱骨頭外下方；供棘上肌、棘下肌與小圓肌附著

refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Anterior, medial to the greater tubercle; carries the subscapularis tendon
位於前方、大結節內側；供肩胛下肌腱附著
supply: Insertion of subscapularis
肩胛下肌的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

origin: On the humerus
肱骨
course: Between the greater and lesser tubercles on the front of the humerus; also called the bicipital groove
位於肱骨前面大、小結節之間；又稱二頭肌溝
supply: Holds the tendon of the long head of biceps brachii
容納肱二頭肌長頭肌腱
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

橈骨

橈骨下端外側的尖突

origin: On the hip bone
髖骨

坐骨後緣、坐骨大切跡與小切跡之間的尖突
supply: Attachment of the sacrospinous ligament; the pudendal nerve and internal pudendal vessels wind round it
薦棘韌帶的附著處；陰部神經與陰部內血管繞過此處

PK-161.name: Left tibial tuberosity
origin: On the tibia
脛骨
course: Rough elevation on the front of the upper tibia
脛骨上端前面的粗糙隆起
supply: Insertion of the patellar ligament
髕韌帶的止點
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-162.name: Mastoid process
origin: On the temporal bone, behind the ear
顳骨上，耳後方
course: A conical projection behind the external acoustic meatus
外耳道後方的圓錐形突起
supply: Attachment of sternocleidomastoid, splenius capitis and longissimus capitis
胸鎖乳突肌、頭夾肌與頭最長肌的附著處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-163.name: Jugular foramen
origin: Skull base, between the petrous part of the temporal bone and the occipital bone
顱底，顳骨岩部與枕骨之間
course: Large opening behind the carotid canal
頸動脈管後方的大孔
supply: Transmits the internal jugular vein and cranial nerves IX, X and XI
通過內頸靜脈與第九、十、十一對腦神經
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-164.name: Superior nuchal line
origin: Back of the occipital bone
枕骨後面
course: A curved ridge running laterally from the external occipital protuberance
由枕外隆凸向兩側延伸的弧形骨嵴
supply: Attachment of trapezius, sternocleidomastoid, splenius capitis and semispinalis capitis
斜方肌、胸鎖乳突肌、頭夾肌與頭半棘肌的附著處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-165.name: Posterior arch of atlas
origin: Atlas (C1)
寰椎（C1）
course: The curved bar of bone closing the vertebral foramen of the atlas at the back
在後方封閉寰椎椎孔的弧形骨條
supply: The vertebral artery lies in a groove on its upper surface; rectus capitis posterior minor attaches to its posterior tubercle
椎動脈位於其上面的溝內；頭後小直肌附著於後結節
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-166.name: Spinous process of axis
origin: Axis (C2)
樞椎（C2）
course: Large bifid spinous process, the first palpable spinous process below the skull
粗大的分叉棘突，是顱骨下方第一個可摸到的棘突
supply: Attachment of obliquus capitis inferior, rectus capitis posterior major and semispinalis cervicis
頭下斜肌、頭後大直肌與頸半棘肌的附著處
refs: Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.)

PK-169.name: Right axillary sheath
course: A tube of fascia that continues the prevertebral fascia of the neck into the axilla
頸部椎前筋膜延伸到腋窩所形成的筋膜管
supply: Encloses the axillary artery and vein and the brachial plexus; a local anaesthetic injected into it spreads along the plexus
包裹腋動脈、腋靜脈與臂神經叢；注入局部麻醉劑可沿神經叢擴散
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-170.name: Right femoral sheath
course: A funnel of fascia continuous with the transversalis and iliopsoas fasciae, about 3–4 cm long below the inguinal ligament
與腹橫筋膜、髂腰筋膜相連的漏斗狀筋膜，在腹股溝韌帶下方約 3–4 公分
supply: Encloses the femoral artery, femoral vein and femoral canal (not the femoral nerve, which lies lateral to it)
包裹股動脈、股靜脈與股管（股神經位於其外側，不在鞘內）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-178.name: Left axillary sheath
course: A tube of fascia that continues the prevertebral fascia of the neck into the axilla
頸部椎前筋膜延伸到腋窩所形成的筋膜管
supply: Encloses the axillary artery and vein and the brachial plexus; a local anaesthetic injected into it spreads along the plexus
包裹腋動脈、腋靜脈與臂神經叢；注入局部麻醉劑可沿神經叢擴散
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-179.name: Left femoral sheath
course: A funnel of fascia continuous with the transversalis and iliopsoas fasciae, about 3–4 cm long below the inguinal ligament
與腹橫筋膜、髂腰筋膜相連的漏斗狀筋膜，在腹股溝韌帶下方約 3–4 公分
supply: Encloses the femoral artery, femoral vein and femoral canal (not the femoral nerve, which lies lateral to it)
包裹股動脈、股靜脈與股管（股神經位於其外側，不在鞘內）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-185.name: rectus sheath
origin: Aponeuroses of external oblique, internal oblique and transversus abdominis
腹外斜肌、腹內斜肌與腹橫肌的腱膜
course: The aponeuroses of the three flat abdominal muscles enclose rectus abdominis; the anterior wall is drawn here
三層腹壁扁肌的腱膜包住腹直肌；此處畫出前壁
supply: Encloses rectus abdominis and the superior and inferior epigastric vessels; fused in the midline as the linea alba
包裹腹直肌與腹壁上、下動脈；在中線融合成白線
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-186.name: thoracolumbar fascia
course: The deep fascia of the back over the erector spinae, thickest in the lumbar region
覆蓋豎脊肌的背部深筋膜，腰部最厚
supply: Encloses the erector spinae; gives origin to latissimus dorsi and transversus abdominis (shown here as its posterior layer)
包裹豎脊肌；是背闊肌與腹橫肌的起點（此處畫出後層）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-197.name: Right quadrangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the surgical neck of the humerus
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨外科頸
course: Behind the shoulder, below the shoulder joint
位於肩後、肩關節下方
supply: Transmits the axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral vessels from the axilla to the back of the shoulder
腋神經與旋肱後血管由腋窩通到肩後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-198.name: Right triangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major and laterally by the long head of triceps
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，外側為肱三頭肌長頭
course: Behind the shoulder, medial to the long head of triceps
位於肩後、肱三頭肌長頭內側
supply: Transmits the circumflex scapular artery from the axilla to the infraspinous fossa
旋肩胛動脈由腋窩通到棘下窩
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-199.name: Right triangular interval
origin: Bounded above by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the humerus (and the lateral head of triceps)
上界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨（與肱三頭肌外側頭）
course: On the back of the arm just below teres major
位於上臂後面、大圓肌正下方
supply: Transmits the radial nerve and the deep brachial artery from the axilla to the radial groove
橈神經與肱深動脈由腋窩通到橈神經溝
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-200.name: Right clavipectoral triangle
origin: Bounded by the clavicle, the deltoid and the clavicular head of pectoralis major
界線為鎖骨、三角肌與胸大肌鎖骨部
course: A small depression below the lateral clavicle, between the deltoid and pectoralis major (the deltopectoral triangle)
鎖骨外側下方、三角肌與胸大肌之間的小凹（三角肌胸大肌三角）
supply: The cephalic vein runs through it to pierce the clavipectoral fascia and join the axillary vein
頭靜脈走過此處，穿過鎖胸筋膜匯入腋靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-201.name: Right axillary fossa
origin: Anterior wall: pectoralis major and minor; posterior wall: subscapularis, teres major, latissimus dorsi; medial wall: serratus anterior and ribs; lateral wall: humerus (intertubercular groove)
前壁：胸大肌與胸小肌；後壁：肩胛下肌、大圓肌、背闊肌；內側壁：前鋸肌與肋骨；外側壁：肱骨（結節間溝）
course: A pyramid-shaped space between the upper arm and the chest wall, with its apex at the cervico-axillary canal
位於上臂與胸壁之間的錐狀空間，頂端為頸腋管
supply: Contains the axillary artery and vein, the cords of the brachial plexus, axillary lymph nodes and fat
內有腋動脈、腋靜脈、臂神經叢各束、腋淋巴結與脂肪
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-202.name: Right carpal tunnel
origin: Floor and sides: the arch of carpal bones; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底與兩側：腕骨弓；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage on the front of the wrist, between the carpal bones and the flexor retinaculum
位於腕前方，介於腕骨與屈肌支持帶之間
supply: Transmits the median nerve and nine flexor tendons (four of flexor digitorum superficialis, four of profundus and flexor pollicis longus)
通過正中神經與九條屈肌腱（屈指淺肌四條、屈指深肌四條、屈拇長肌一條）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-203.name: Right tarsal tunnel
origin: Floor: the tibia, talus and calcaneus; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底：脛骨、距骨與跟骨；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage behind and below the medial malleolus
位於內踝後下方的通道
supply: Transmits the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus, the posterior tibial vessels and the tibial nerve into the sole
脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱與脛後血管、脛神經由此進入足底
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-204.name: Right cubital fossa
origin: Base: an imaginary line between the humeral epicondyles; medial border: pronator teres; lateral border: brachioradialis; floor: brachialis and supinator; roof: deep fascia and the bicipital aponeurosis
底：兩肱骨上髁連線；內側界：旋前圓肌；外側界：肱橈肌；底面：肱肌與旋後肌；頂：深筋膜與肱二頭肌腱膜
course: A triangular hollow on the front of the elbow
位於肘前方的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains, from medial to lateral, the median nerve, the brachial artery (dividing into radial and ulnar arteries), the biceps tendon and the radial nerve (deep branch); the median cubital vein crosses its roof
由內向外含正中神經、肱動脈（在此分為橈動脈與尺動脈）、肱二頭肌腱與橈神經（深支）；肘正中靜脈橫越其頂
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-205.name: Right anatomical snuffbox
origin: Ulnar (posterior) border: tendon of extensor pollicis longus; radial (anterior) border: tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis; floor: scaphoid and trapezium
尺側（後）界：拇長伸肌腱；橈側（前）界：拇長展肌腱與拇短伸肌腱；底：舟狀骨與大多角骨
course: A triangular hollow on the back of the wrist at the base of the thumb
位於腕背、拇指基部的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains the radial artery (crossing its floor) and the superficial branch of the radial nerve, with the cephalic vein over its roof; tenderness here suggests a scaphoid fracture
橈動脈由其底部橫過，橈神經淺支與頭靜脈行於頂部；此處壓痛要懷疑舟狀骨骨折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-206.name: Right adductor hiatus
origin: Between the oblique and vertical parts of the attachment of adductor magnus
位於內收大肌斜行部與垂直部止點之間
course: The gap in the lower end of adductor magnus, above the medial femoral condyle
內收大肌下端、股骨內側髁上方的裂隙
supply: The femoral vessels pass through it from the adductor canal into the popliteal fossa (becoming the popliteal vessels)
股血管由內收肌管經此進入膕窩（成為膕血管）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-207.name: Right suboccipital triangle
origin: Bounded by rectus capitis posterior major (medially), obliquus capitis superior (laterally) and obliquus capitis inferior (inferiorly); roof: semispinalis capitis; floor: posterior atlanto-occipital membrane and the posterior arch of the atlas
界線：頭後大直肌（內側）、頭上斜肌（外側）、頭下斜肌（下方）；頂：頭半棘肌；底：寰枕後膜與寰椎後弓
course: A small muscular triangle deep in the back of the neck, below the occipital bone
位於後頸深層、枕骨下方的小肌肉三角
supply: Contains the vertebral artery (third part), the suboccipital nerve and the suboccipital venous plexus
內有椎動脈（第三段）、枕下神經與枕下靜脈叢
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-208.name: Left quadrangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the surgical neck of the humerus
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨外科頸
course: Behind the shoulder, below the shoulder joint
位於肩後、肩關節下方
supply: Transmits the axillary nerve and the posterior circumflex humeral vessels from the axilla to the back of the shoulder
腋神經與旋肱後血管由腋窩通到肩後方
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-209.name: Left triangular space
origin: Bounded above by teres minor, below by teres major and laterally by the long head of triceps
上界為小圓肌，下界為大圓肌，外側為肱三頭肌長頭
course: Behind the shoulder, medial to the long head of triceps
位於肩後、肱三頭肌長頭內側
supply: Transmits the circumflex scapular artery from the axilla to the infraspinous fossa
旋肩胛動脈由腋窩通到棘下窩
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-210.name: Left triangular interval
origin: Bounded above by teres major, medially by the long head of triceps and laterally by the humerus (and the lateral head of triceps)
上界為大圓肌，內側為肱三頭肌長頭，外側為肱骨（與肱三頭肌外側頭）
course: On the back of the arm just below teres major
位於上臂後面、大圓肌正下方
supply: Transmits the radial nerve and the deep brachial artery from the axilla to the radial groove
橈神經與肱深動脈由腋窩通到橈神經溝
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-211.name: Left clavipectoral triangle
origin: Bounded by the clavicle, the deltoid and the clavicular head of pectoralis major
界線為鎖骨、三角肌與胸大肌鎖骨部
course: A small depression below the lateral clavicle, between the deltoid and pectoralis major (the deltopectoral triangle)
鎖骨外側下方、三角肌與胸大肌之間的小凹（三角肌胸大肌三角）
supply: The cephalic vein runs through it to pierce the clavipectoral fascia and join the axillary vein
頭靜脈走過此處，穿過鎖胸筋膜匯入腋靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-212.name: Left axillary fossa
origin: Anterior wall: pectoralis major and minor; posterior wall: subscapularis, teres major, latissimus dorsi; medial wall: serratus anterior and ribs; lateral wall: humerus (intertubercular groove)
前壁：胸大肌與胸小肌；後壁：肩胛下肌、大圓肌、背闊肌；內側壁：前鋸肌與肋骨；外側壁：肱骨（結節間溝）
course: A pyramid-shaped space between the upper arm and the chest wall, with its apex at the cervico-axillary canal
位於上臂與胸壁之間的錐狀空間，頂端為頸腋管
supply: Contains the axillary artery and vein, the cords of the brachial plexus, axillary lymph nodes and fat
內有腋動脈、腋靜脈、臂神經叢各束、腋淋巴結與脂肪
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-213.name: Left carpal tunnel
origin: Floor and sides: the arch of carpal bones; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底與兩側：腕骨弓；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage on the front of the wrist, between the carpal bones and the flexor retinaculum
位於腕前方，介於腕骨與屈肌支持帶之間
supply: Transmits the median nerve and nine flexor tendons (four of flexor digitorum superficialis, four of profundus and flexor pollicis longus)
通過正中神經與九條屈肌腱（屈指淺肌四條、屈指深肌四條、屈拇長肌一條）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-214.name: Left tarsal tunnel
origin: Floor: the tibia, talus and calcaneus; roof: the flexor retinaculum
底：脛骨、距骨與跟骨；頂：屈肌支持帶
course: A passage behind and below the medial malleolus
位於內踝後下方的通道
supply: Transmits the tendons of tibialis posterior, flexor digitorum longus and flexor hallucis longus, the posterior tibial vessels and the tibial nerve into the sole
脛後肌、屈趾長肌、屈拇長肌肌腱與脛後血管、脛神經由此進入足底
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-215.name: Left cubital fossa
origin: Base: an imaginary line between the humeral epicondyles; medial border: pronator teres; lateral border: brachioradialis; floor: brachialis and supinator; roof: deep fascia and the bicipital aponeurosis
底：兩肱骨上髁連線；內側界：旋前圓肌；外側界：肱橈肌；底面：肱肌與旋後肌；頂：深筋膜與肱二頭肌腱膜

位於肘前方的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains, from medial to lateral, the median nerve, the brachial artery (dividing into radial and ulnar arteries), the biceps tendon and the radial nerve (deep branch); the median cubital vein crosses its roof

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-216.name: Left anatomical snuffbox
origin: Ulnar (posterior) border: tendon of extensor pollicis longus; radial (anterior) border: tendons of abductor pollicis longus and extensor pollicis brevis; floor: scaphoid and trapezium
尺側（後）界：拇長伸肌腱；橈側（前）界：拇長展肌腱與拇短伸肌腱；底：舟狀骨與大多角骨
