位於腕背、拇指基部的三角形凹陷
supply: Contains the radial artery (crossing its floor) and the superficial branch of the radial nerve, with the cephalic vein over its roof; tenderness here suggests a scaphoid fracture
橈動脈由其底部橫過，橈神經淺支與頭靜脈行於頂部；此處壓痛要懷疑舟狀骨骨折
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-217.name: Left adductor hiatus
origin: Between the oblique and vertical parts of the attachment of adductor magnus
位於內收大肌斜行部與垂直部止點之間
course: The gap in the lower end of adductor magnus, above the medial femoral condyle
內收大肌下端、股骨內側髁上方的裂隙
supply: The femoral vessels pass through it from the adductor canal into the popliteal fossa (becoming the popliteal vessels)
股血管由內收肌管經此進入膕窩（成為膕血管）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-218.name: Left suboccipital triangle
origin: Bounded by rectus capitis posterior major (medially), obliquus capitis superior (laterally) and obliquus capitis inferior (inferiorly); roof: semispinalis capitis; floor: posterior atlanto-occipital membrane and the posterior arch of the atlas
界線：頭後大直肌（內側）、頭上斜肌（外側）、頭下斜肌（下方）；頂：頭半棘肌；底：寰枕後膜與寰椎後弓
course: A small muscular triangle deep in the back of the neck, below the occipital bone
位於後頸深層、枕骨下方的小肌肉三角
supply: Contains the vertebral artery (third part), the suboccipital nerve and the suboccipital venous plexus
內有椎動脈（第三段）、枕下神經與枕下靜脈叢
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-219.name: Aortic hiatus
origin: Diaphragm, at the level of T12, behind the median arcuate ligament
橫膈，T12 高度、正中弓狀韌帶後方
course: The opening between the right and left crura of the diaphragm
橫膈左右腳之間的開口
supply: Transmits the aorta, the thoracic duct and often the azygos vein
通過主動脈、胸管，常並有奇靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-220.name: Right denticulate ligament
origin: Pia mater on the side of the spinal cord, between the dorsal and ventral roots
脊髓側面的軟膜，位於背根與腹根之間
course: A series of about 21 triangular teeth that attach to the dura mater
約 21 個三角形齒突，附著於硬脊膜
supply: Suspends the spinal cord in the dural sac; it marks the boundary between the dorsal and ventral roots
把脊髓懸吊在硬膜囊內；是區分背根與腹根的標誌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-221.name: Left denticulate ligament
origin: Pia mater on the side of the spinal cord, between the dorsal and ventral roots
脊髓側面的軟膜，位於背根與腹根之間
course: A series of about 21 triangular teeth that attach to the dura mater
約 21 個三角形齒突，附著於硬脊膜
supply: Suspends the spinal cord in the dural sac; it marks the boundary between the dorsal and ventral roots
把脊髓懸吊在硬膜囊內；是區分背根與腹根的標誌
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-222.name: Ligamentum flavum
origin: Lamina of the vertebra above
上一節椎骨的椎弓板
course: Yellow elastic bands joining the laminae of adjacent vertebrae on the inside of the vertebral canal, behind the spinal cord
連接相鄰椎弓板的黃色彈性纖維帶，位於椎管內脊髓後方
supply: Resists excessive flexion and helps the spine return to the upright posture
限制過度前屈，並協助脊柱回復直立
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-223.name: Right palmaris brevis
origin: Flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis
屈肌支持帶與掌腱膜
insertion: Skin of the ulnar border of the palm, over the hypothenar eminence
手掌尺側緣、小魚際隆起上的皮膚
action: Wrinkles the skin of the hypothenar eminence and deepens the hollow of the palm
使小魚際的皮膚皺起並加深掌心凹
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-224.name: Right transversus thoracis
origin: Posterior surface of the lower sternum and xiphoid process
胸骨下部與劍突後面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd–6th costal cartilages
第二至第六肋軟骨內面
action: Depresses the costal cartilages (weak expiration)
下壓肋軟骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-225.name: Right subcostal muscles
origin: Inner surface of the lower ribs near their angles
下位肋骨角附近的內面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd or 3rd rib below, in the same direction as the innermost intercostals
下方第二或第三條肋骨的內面，方向與最內肋間肌相同
action: Depress the ribs (weak expiration)
下拉肋骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-226.name: Left palmaris brevis
origin: Flexor retinaculum and palmar aponeurosis
屈肌支持帶與掌腱膜
insertion: Skin of the ulnar border of the palm, over the hypothenar eminence
手掌尺側緣、小魚際隆起上的皮膚
action: Wrinkles the skin of the hypothenar eminence and deepens the hollow of the palm
使小魚際的皮膚皺起並加深掌心凹
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-227.name: Left transversus thoracis
origin: Posterior surface of the lower sternum and xiphoid process
胸骨下部與劍突後面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd–6th costal cartilages
第二至第六肋軟骨內面
action: Depresses the costal cartilages (weak expiration)
下壓肋軟骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-228.name: Left subcostal muscles
origin: Inner surface of the lower ribs near their angles
下位肋骨角附近的內面
insertion: Inner surface of the 2nd or 3rd rib below, in the same direction as the innermost intercostals
下方第二或第三條肋骨的內面，方向與最內肋間肌相同
action: Depress the ribs (weak expiration)
下拉肋骨（微弱的呼氣作用）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-229.name: Oblique fissure of right lung

extra.en: Deep cleft running obliquely down and forwards across the right lung
extra.zh: 右肺由後上斜向前下的深裂

extra.en: Separates the lower lobe from the upper and middle lobes
extra.zh: 分隔下葉與上葉、中葉

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-230.name: Horizontal fissure of right lung

extra.en: Short cleft running horizontally at the level of the 4th costal cartilage on the right lung
extra.zh: 右肺約在第 4 肋軟骨高度水平走行的短裂

extra.en: Separates the upper lobe from the middle lobe; only the right lung has it
extra.zh: 分隔上葉與中葉；只有右肺有水平裂

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-231.name: Oblique fissure of left lung

extra.en: Deep cleft running obliquely down and forwards across the left lung
extra.zh: 左肺由後上斜向前下的深裂

extra.en: Separates the upper lobe (with the lingula) from the lower lobe
extra.zh: 分隔上葉（含舌葉）與下葉

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-232.name: Lingula of left lung

extra.en: Lower front part of the left upper lobe, below the cardiac notch
extra.zh: 左肺上葉前下部，心切跡下方

extra.en: Superior lingular segment and inferior lingular segment
extra.zh: 上舌段與下舌段

extra.en: Cardiac notch above and in front; the oblique fissure separates it from the lower lobe behind
extra.zh: 前上方是心切跡；後方以斜裂與下葉相隔

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-233.name: Cardiac notch of left lung

extra.en: Front edge of the left upper lobe, below the anterior border
extra.zh: 左肺上葉前緣下部

extra.en: The lingula lies below it; the notch leaves part of the pericardium uncovered by lung
extra.zh: 舌葉在其下方；切跡使一部分心包沒有被肺覆蓋

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-234.name: Cardiac impression of left lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the left lung, in front of and below the hilum
extra.zh: 左肺縱隔面，肺門的前下方

extra.en: Heart (mainly the left ventricle), through the pericardium
extra.zh: 心臟（主要是左心室），隔著心包

extra.en: Thymic contact area above it; the cardiac notch lies on the front edge in front of it
extra.zh: 上方是胸腺接觸區；前緣上的心切跡位於其前方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-235.name: Cardiac impression of right lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the right lung, in front of the hilum
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面，肺門的前方

extra.en: Heart (right atrium), through the pericardium
extra.zh: 心臟（右心房），隔著心包

extra.en: Merges above with the groove for the superior vena cava and below with the groove for the inferior vena cava
extra.zh: 上方接上腔靜脈溝，下方接下腔靜脈溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-236.name: Groove for aortic arch

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the left upper lobe, arching over the hilum from front to back
extra.zh: 左肺上葉縱隔面，由前向後跨過肺門上方

extra.en: Arch of the aorta
extra.zh: 主動脈弓

extra.en: Continues down as the groove for the descending aorta; the groove for the left subclavian artery rises from it and the groove for the left brachiocephalic vein lies in front and above
extra.zh: 向下延續為降主動脈溝；左鎖骨下動脈溝由它向上延伸，左頭臂靜脈溝在其前上方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-237.name: Groove for descending aorta

extra.en: Mediastinal surface behind the hilum, on the upper and lower lobes
extra.zh: 縱隔面肺門後方，橫跨上葉與下葉

extra.en: Descending thoracic aorta
extra.zh: 胸主動脈（降主動脈）

extra.en: Continues up from the groove for the aortic arch; the esophageal impression lies in front of it
extra.zh: 向上接主動脈弓溝；食道壓跡在其前方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-238.name: Left groove for subclavian artery

extra.en: Upper part of the mediastinal surface, rising from the aortic arch groove towards the apex
extra.zh: 縱隔面上部，由主動脈弓溝向肺尖上行

extra.en: Left subclavian artery
extra.zh: 左鎖骨下動脈

extra.en: Starts at the groove for the aortic arch; the groove for the left brachiocephalic vein lies in front of it
extra.zh: 起自主動脈弓溝；左頭臂靜脈溝在其前方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-239.name: Right groove for subclavian artery

extra.en: Upper part of the mediastinal surface, arching over the apex
extra.zh: 縱隔面上部，向上繞過肺尖

extra.en: Right subclavian artery
extra.zh: 右鎖骨下動脈

extra.en: Lies behind the groove for the right brachiocephalic vein
extra.zh: 在右頭臂靜脈溝後方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-240.name: Groove for left brachiocephalic vein

extra.en: Upper part of the mediastinal surface, in front of and above the aortic arch groove
extra.zh: 縱隔面上部，主動脈弓溝的前上方

extra.en: Left brachiocephalic vein
extra.zh: 左頭臂靜脈

extra.en: The grooves for the aortic arch and left subclavian artery lie behind it; the thymic contact area lies in front and below
extra.zh: 主動脈弓溝與左鎖骨下動脈溝在其後方；胸腺接觸區在其前下方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-241.name: Groove for brachiocephalic vein

extra.en: Top of the mediastinal surface of the right lung, below the apex
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面頂部，肺尖下方

extra.en: Right brachiocephalic vein
extra.zh: 右頭臂靜脈

extra.en: Continues down into the groove for the superior vena cava; the groove for the subclavian artery lies behind it
extra.zh: 向下延續為上腔靜脈溝；鎖骨下動脈溝在其後方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-242.name: Groove for superior vena cava

extra.en: Front part of the mediastinal surface of the right lung, running vertically in front of the hilum
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面前部，在肺門前方垂直向下

extra.en: Superior vena cava
extra.zh: 上腔靜脈

extra.en: Continues up as the groove for the brachiocephalic vein; the groove for the azygos vein ends in it from behind; the cardiac impression lies below
extra.zh: 向上延續為頭臂靜脈溝；奇靜脈溝由後方接入；下方是心壓跡

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-243.name: Groove for azygos vein

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the right lung above the hilum, arching from behind forwards
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面，肺門上方，由後向前呈弓形

extra.en: Arch of the azygos vein, where it joins the superior vena cava
extra.zh: 奇靜脈弓（注入上腔靜脈處）

extra.en: Ends in front at the groove for the superior vena cava; the esophageal groove lies behind and below it
extra.zh: 前端接上腔靜脈溝；食道溝在其後下方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-244.name: Esophageal impression of left lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface behind the hilum, below the aortic arch groove
extra.zh: 縱隔面肺門後方，主動脈弓溝下方

extra.en: Esophagus
extra.zh: 食道

extra.en: Lies in front of the groove for the descending aorta, below the groove for the aortic arch
extra.zh: 在降主動脈溝前方、主動脈弓溝下方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-245.name: Groove for inferior vena cava

extra.en: Lower part of the mediastinal surface of the right lung, in front of the pulmonary ligament
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面下部，肺韌帶前方

extra.en: Inferior vena cava
extra.zh: 下腔靜脈

extra.en: Below the cardiac impression, with which it merges above
extra.zh: 在心壓跡下方，上端與心壓跡相連

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-246.name: Groove for esophagus

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the right lung behind the hilum, below the azygos groove
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面肺門後方，奇靜脈溝下方

extra.en: Esophagus
extra.zh: 食道

extra.en: Below the groove for the azygos vein; the groove for the inferior vena cava lies lower in front
extra.zh: 在奇靜脈溝下方；下腔靜脈溝在其下前方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-247.name: Hilum of left lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the left lung
extra.zh: 左肺縱隔面

extra.en: Main bronchus, pulmonary artery, superior and inferior pulmonary veins, bronchial arteries and veins, pulmonary nerve plexus, lymphatics and bronchopulmonary lymph nodes
extra.zh: 主支氣管、肺動脈、上肺靜脈與下肺靜脈、支氣管動脈與靜脈、肺神經叢、淋巴管與支氣管肺門淋巴結

extra.en: Top to bottom: pulmonary artery, main bronchus, pulmonary veins (the artery arches over the bronchus). Front to back: pulmonary veins, pulmonary artery, bronchus. The phrenic nerve passes in front of the root and the vagus nerve behind it
extra.zh: 由上到下：肺動脈、主支氣管、肺靜脈（動脈由上方跨過支氣管）；由前到後：肺靜脈、肺動脈、支氣管；膈神經經肺根前方，迷走神經經肺根後方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-248.name: Hilum of right lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the right lung
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面

extra.en: Main bronchus, pulmonary artery, superior and inferior pulmonary veins, bronchial arteries and veins, pulmonary nerve plexus, lymphatics and bronchopulmonary lymph nodes
extra.zh: 主支氣管、肺動脈、上肺靜脈與下肺靜脈、支氣管動脈與靜脈、肺神經叢、淋巴管與支氣管肺門淋巴結

extra.en: Top to bottom: upper-lobe bronchus (above the artery), pulmonary artery, pulmonary veins. Front to back: pulmonary veins, pulmonary artery, bronchus. The phrenic nerve passes in front of the root and the vagus nerve behind it
extra.zh: 由上到下：上葉支氣管（在動脈上方）、肺動脈、肺靜脈；由前到後：肺靜脈、肺動脈、支氣管；膈神經經肺根前方，迷走神經經肺根後方

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-249.name: Left pulmonary ligament
origin: Mediastinal surface of the lower lobe, below the root of the lung
下葉縱隔面、肺根下方
course: A fold of pleura running down from the root of the lung to the diaphragm and mediastinum
由肺根向下延伸到橫膈與縱隔的胸膜皺褶
supply: Lets the lung root move with breathing; the inferior pulmonary vein lies at its upper end and the ligament is cut in lung surgery
讓肺根隨呼吸移動；下肺靜脈在其上端，肺葉手術時需切開
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-250.name: Right pulmonary ligament
origin: Mediastinal surface of the lower lobe, below the root of the lung
下葉縱隔面、肺根下方
course: A fold of pleura running down from the root of the lung to the diaphragm and mediastinum
由肺根向下延伸到橫膈與縱隔的胸膜皺褶
supply: Lets the lung root move with breathing; the inferior pulmonary vein lies at its upper end and the ligament is cut in lung surgery
讓肺根隨呼吸移動；下肺靜脈在其上端，肺葉手術時需切開
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-251.name: Right C1 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C1, between the occipital bone and the atlas
由第一頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-252.name: Right C2 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C2, between the atlas and the axis
由第二頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C3, between the third cervical vertebra and the one below
由第三頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

由第四頸神經的腹根與背根合成

離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the cervical plexus (C1–C4)
前支參與頸神經叢（C1–C4）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-255.name: Right C5 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C5, between the fifth cervical vertebra and the one below
由第五頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the brachial plexus (C5–T1)
前支參與臂神經叢（C5–T1）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-256.name: Right C6 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C6, between the sixth cervical vertebra and the one below
由第六頸神經的腹根與背根合成

離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the brachial plexus (C5–T1)
前支參與臂神經叢（C5–T1）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-257.name: Right C7 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C7, between the seventh cervical vertebra and the one below
由第七頸神經的腹根與背根合成
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）

PK-258.name: Right C8 spinal nerve
origin: Formed by the union of the ventral and dorsal roots of C8, between the 7th cervical and 1st thoracic vertebrae
由第八頸神經的腹根與背根合成，位於第七頸椎與第一胸椎之間
course: Leaves the vertebral canal, then divides at once into a ventral ramus (to the cervical and brachial plexuses) and a dorsal ramus (to the deep back muscles and the skin of the back of the neck and scalp)
離開椎管後立即分成前支（參與頸神經叢與臂神經叢）與後支（支配深層背肌與後頸、後頭皮膚）
supply: Its ventral ramus contributes to the brachial plexus (C5–T1)
前支參與臂神經叢（C5–T1）
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-259.name: Right dorsal ramus of C1 spinal nerve
origin: C1 spinal nerve, just outside the vertebral arch
第一頸脊神經，在椎弓外側
course: The C1 dorsal ramus is the suboccipital nerve: it passes above the posterior arch of the atlas into the suboccipital triangle
第一頸神經後支即枕下神經，由寰椎後弓上方進入枕下三角

PK-283.name: Right mammary gland
origin: Modified sweat gland on the front of the chest, lying on the pectoral fascia over pectoralis major (upper two thirds) and serratus anterior, from the 2nd to the 6th rib
變形的汗腺，位於前胸壁胸肌筋膜上，覆蓋胸大肌（上三分之二）與前鋸肌，由第二到第六肋

15–20 個乳腺葉經輸乳管通到乳頭；庫柏懸韌帶連接腺體與皮膚；外上方的腋尾伸向腋窩
supply: Arteries: lateral thoracic, thoraco-acromial and internal thoracic (medial mammary) branches and the posterior intercostal arteries. Nerves: anterior and lateral cutaneous branches of the 4th–6th intercostal nerves. Lymph: about 75% to the axillary nodes, the rest to the parasternal nodes
動脈：胸外側動脈、胸肩峰動脈、胸廓內動脈（內側乳房支）與後肋間動脈；神經：第四至第六肋間神經的前、外側皮支；淋巴：約 75% 回流腋淋巴結，其餘到胸骨旁淋巴結

與胸肌筋膜之間隔著乳後間隙，使乳房能在胸壁上滑動

朝乳頭走行，在乳頭後方擴大成輸乳竇

把乳汁送到乳頭；多數乳癌起自輸乳管上皮

PK-290.name: Left mammary gland
origin: Modified sweat gland on the front of the chest, lying on the pectoral fascia over pectoralis major (upper two thirds) and serratus anterior, from the 2nd to the 6th rib
變形的汗腺，位於前胸壁胸肌筋膜上，覆蓋胸大肌（上三分之二）與前鋸肌，由第二到第六肋
course: 15–20 lobes drain by lactiferous ducts to the nipple; the suspensory ligaments (of Cooper) run between the gland and the skin; an axillary tail extends to the axilla
15–20 個乳腺葉經輸乳管通到乳頭；庫柏懸韌帶連接腺體與皮膚；外上方的腋尾伸向腋窩
supply: Arteries: lateral thoracic, thoraco-acromial and internal thoracic (medial mammary) branches and the posterior intercostal arteries. Nerves: anterior and lateral cutaneous branches of the 4th–6th intercostal nerves. Lymph: about 75% to the axillary nodes, the rest to the parasternal nodes
動脈：胸外側動脈、胸肩峰動脈、胸廓內動脈（內側乳房支）與後肋間動脈；神經：第四至第六肋間神經的前、外側皮支；淋巴：約 75% 回流腋淋巴結，其餘到胸骨旁淋巴結
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-291.name: Left adipose tissue of breast
origin: Subcutaneous and retromammary fat that surrounds the gland and gives the breast its shape
包住乳腺、決定乳房外形的皮下脂肪與乳後脂肪
course: Separated from the pectoral fascia by the retromammary space, which lets the breast slide over the chest wall
與胸肌筋膜之間隔著乳後間隙，使乳房能在胸壁上滑動
supply: Same arteries and lymph drainage as the gland
血液供應與淋巴引流和乳腺相同
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-292.name: Left lactiferous ducts
origin: Each lobe drains by one main duct
每個乳腺葉由一條主輸乳管引流
course: Run towards the nipple and widen into the lactiferous sinus just behind it
朝乳頭走行，在乳頭後方擴大成輸乳竇
supply: Carry milk to the nipple; most breast cancers start in the duct lining
把乳汁送到乳頭；多數乳癌起自輸乳管上皮
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-293.name: Left lactiferous sinuses
origin: Dilated end of each main lactiferous duct, behind the nipple
主輸乳管靠近乳頭的膨大末端
course: Each opens on the tip of the nipple by its own small pore
各自以一個小孔開口於乳頭頂端
supply: Store a little milk between feeds
哺乳之間暫存少量乳汁
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-294.name: Left areola
origin: The pigmented skin circle round the nipple
乳頭周圍有色素的皮膚圓區
course: About 3–4 cm across; the small bumps on it (areolar or Montgomery tubercles) are glands that lubricate the nipple
直徑約 3–4 公分；上面的小突起（蒙哥馬利結節）是潤滑乳頭的腺體
supply: Sensory supply by the 4th intercostal nerve
由第四肋間神經司感覺
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-295.name: Left nipple
origin: Centre of the areola, at the 4th intercostal space in the midclavicular line (in the male and in most women)
乳暈中央，位於第四肋間隙、鎖骨中線（男性與多數女性）
course: The lactiferous ducts open on it; smooth muscle fibres make it erect
輸乳管開口於此；平滑肌使乳頭挺起
supply: Dermatome T4; rich in sensory endings
皮節 T4，感覺神經末梢豐富
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-296.name: Left suspensory ligament of breast
PK-296.zh: 左乳房懸韌帶（庫柏氏韌帶）
origin: Deep fascia over pectoralis major
胸大肌表面的深筋膜
course: Fibrous septa running through the breast between the lobules to the dermis of the skin
穿過乳腺小葉之間、連到皮膚真皮的纖維隔
supply: Support the breast; invasion by cancer can pull on them and dimple the skin
支撐乳房；乳癌侵犯時牽拉而使皮膚凹陷
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Human Reference Atlas 3D Reference Organs: mammary gland, female, v1.1 (CC BY 4.0), Kristen Browne and Heidi Schlehlein

PK-297.name: Mons pubis
origin: The fatty pad over the pubic symphysis and the pubic bones
恥骨聯合與恥骨上的脂肪墊
course: Covered with pubic hair after puberty; continues into the labia majora
青春期後長出陰毛，向下延續為大陰唇
supply: Ilio-inguinal and genital branches of the genitofemoral nerve; superficial external pudendal vessels
髂腹股溝神經與生殖股神經生殖支；淺層陰部外動脈與靜脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-298.name: Right labium majus
origin: Fold of skin and fat from the mons pubis to the perineum, on either side of the vulva
由陰阜延伸到會陰的皮膚與脂肪皺褶，位於外陰兩側
course: Covers the labia minora and the vestibule; contains the end of the round ligament of the uterus
覆蓋小陰唇與陰道前庭，含子宮圓韌帶的末端
supply: Ilio-inguinal, genitofemoral and perineal nerves; labial branches of the internal and external pudendal arteries
髂腹股溝神經、生殖股神經與會陰神經；陰部內、外動脈的陰唇支
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Position estimated on a male pelvis (see the note on the vulva)

PK-299.name: Right labium minus
origin: Thin hairless folds of skin inside the labia majora, bounding the vestibule
大陰唇內側無毛的薄皮膚皺褶，圍成陰道前庭
course: Split in front to enclose the clitoris (prepuce and frenulum) and join behind at the frenulum of the labia
前方分開包住陰蒂（陰蒂包皮與繫帶），後方在陰唇繫帶會合
supply: Ilio-inguinal and perineal nerves; labial branches of the internal pudendal artery
髂腹股溝神經與會陰神經；陰部內動脈的陰唇支
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-300.name: Right bulb of vestibule
origin: Erectile tissue on each side of the vaginal orifice, deep to the labia minora
位於陰道口兩側、小陰唇深面的勃起組織
course: Joined in front by a narrow band under the clitoris; covered by bulbospongiosus
前方以細帶在陰蒂下方相連；被球海綿體肌覆蓋
supply: Perineal branches of the pudendal nerve; artery of the bulb of the vestibule
陰部神經會陰支；前庭球動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-301.name: Right greater vestibular gland
origin: Pea-sized gland behind each vestibular bulb, deep to the posterior part of the labium majus
位於前庭球後方、大陰唇後部深面的豌豆大小腺體
course: Its duct opens in the groove between the hymen and the labium minus, near the middle of the vestibule
導管開口於處女膜與小陰唇之間的溝，約在前庭中部
supply: Secretes mucus during arousal; blockage causes a Bartholin cyst
性興奮時分泌黏液；導管阻塞形成巴氏腺囊腫
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-302.name: Right crus of clitoris
origin: Ischiopubic ramus, covered by ischiocavernosus
附著於坐骨恥骨支，被坐骨海綿體肌覆蓋
course: Passes forwards and medially to join its fellow and form the body of the clitoris
向前內側走行，與對側會合形成陰蒂體
supply: Dorsal nerve of the clitoris (pudendal nerve); deep artery of the clitoris
陰蒂背神經（陰部神經）；陰蒂深動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-303.name: Left labium majus
origin: Fold of skin and fat from the mons pubis to the perineum, on either side of the vulva
由陰阜延伸到會陰的皮膚與脂肪皺褶，位於外陰兩側
course: Covers the labia minora and the vestibule; contains the end of the round ligament of the uterus
覆蓋小陰唇與陰道前庭，含子宮圓韌帶的末端
supply: Ilio-inguinal, genitofemoral and perineal nerves; labial branches of the internal and external pudendal arteries
髂腹股溝神經、生殖股神經與會陰神經；陰部內、外動脈的陰唇支
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
Position estimated on a male pelvis (see the note on the vulva)

PK-304.name: Left labium minus
origin: Thin hairless folds of skin inside the labia majora, bounding the vestibule
大陰唇內側無毛的薄皮膚皺褶，圍成陰道前庭
course: Split in front to enclose the clitoris (prepuce and frenulum) and join behind at the frenulum of the labia
前方分開包住陰蒂（陰蒂包皮與繫帶），後方在陰唇繫帶會合
supply: Ilio-inguinal and perineal nerves; labial branches of the internal pudendal artery
髂腹股溝神經與會陰神經；陰部內動脈的陰唇支
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-305.name: Left bulb of vestibule
origin: Erectile tissue on each side of the vaginal orifice, deep to the labia minora
位於陰道口兩側、小陰唇深面的勃起組織
course: Joined in front by a narrow band under the clitoris; covered by bulbospongiosus
前方以細帶在陰蒂下方相連；被球海綿體肌覆蓋
supply: Perineal branches of the pudendal nerve; artery of the bulb of the vestibule
陰部神經會陰支；前庭球動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-306.name: Left greater vestibular gland
origin: Pea-sized gland behind each vestibular bulb, deep to the posterior part of the labium majus
位於前庭球後方、大陰唇後部深面的豌豆大小腺體
course: Its duct opens in the groove between the hymen and the labium minus, near the middle of the vestibule
導管開口於處女膜與小陰唇之間的溝，約在前庭中部
supply: Secretes mucus during arousal; blockage causes a Bartholin cyst
性興奮時分泌黏液；導管阻塞形成巴氏腺囊腫
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-307.name: Left crus of clitoris
origin: Ischiopubic ramus, covered by ischiocavernosus
附著於坐骨恥骨支，被坐骨海綿體肌覆蓋
course: Passes forwards and medially to join its fellow and form the body of the clitoris
向前內側走行，與對側會合形成陰蒂體
supply: Dorsal nerve of the clitoris (pudendal nerve); deep artery of the clitoris
陰蒂背神經（陰部神經）；陰蒂深動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-308.name: Clitoris
origin: Erectile organ at the front of the vulva: glans, body and two crura attached to the ischiopubic rami
外陰前方的勃起器官：陰蒂頭、陰蒂體與附著於坐骨恥骨支的兩個陰蒂腳
course: The body bends sharply down under the pubic symphysis; the glans is covered by the prepuce formed by the labia minora
陰蒂體在恥骨聯合下方急轉向下；陰蒂頭被小陰唇形成的包皮覆蓋
supply: Dorsal nerve of the clitoris (pudendal nerve, S2–S4); dorsal and deep arteries of the clitoris
陰蒂背神經（陰部神經，S2–S4）；陰蒂背動脈與深動脈
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-309.name: Vestibule of vagina
origin: The cleft between the labia minora
兩側小陰唇之間的裂隙
course: The urethra opens in front and the vagina behind it; the ducts of the greater vestibular glands open at each side
尿道口在前、陰道口在後；前庭大腺導管開口於兩側
supply: Nerve supply from the pudendal nerve (S2–S4)
陰部神經（S2–S4）支配
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 1 Back, ch. 3 Thorax and ch. 5 Pelvis and perineum; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-325.name: Apex of right lung

extra.en: Top of the right lung, rising above the first rib into the root of the neck
extra.zh: 右肺最上端，越過第 1 肋進入頸根

extra.en: Covered by the cervical pleura; the right subclavian artery grooves it from in front
extra.zh: 外覆胸膜頂；右鎖骨下動脈由前方壓出溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-326.name: Groove for first rib of right lung

extra.en: Near the apex of the right lung, on the side facing the first rib
extra.zh: 右肺肺尖附近，朝向第 1 肋的一側

extra.en: First rib
extra.zh: 第 1 肋

extra.en: The groove for the right subclavian artery lies on the mediastinal side of the apex
extra.zh: 右鎖骨下動脈溝在肺尖的縱隔側

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-327.name: Contact area for thymus of right lung

extra.en: Front part of the mediastinal surface of the right lung, above the cardiac impression
extra.zh: 右肺縱隔面前部，心壓跡上方

extra.en: Thymus (or its fatty remnant) in the anterior mediastinum
extra.zh: 前縱隔的胸腺（或其脂肪殘餘）

extra.en: Groove for the superior vena cava and brachiocephalic vein behind it
extra.zh: 後方是上腔靜脈溝與頭臂靜脈溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-328.name: Contact area for trachea of right lung

extra.en: Mediastinal surface of the right upper lobe, above the hilum
extra.zh: 右肺上葉縱隔面，肺門上方

extra.en: Trachea, through the pleura
extra.zh: 氣管，隔著胸膜

extra.en: The groove for the azygos vein arches below it; the groove for the right subclavian artery lies above and behind
extra.zh: 下方是奇靜脈溝；後上方是右鎖骨下動脈溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-329.name: Anterior border of right lung

extra.en: Front edge of the right lung, between the costal and mediastinal surfaces
extra.zh: 右肺前緣，位於肋面與縱隔面之間

extra.en: Thin and sharp; runs down in front of the root of the lung without a notch
extra.zh: 薄而銳；在肺根前方向下延伸，沒有切跡

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-330.name: Diaphragmatic surface of right lung

extra.en: Base of the right lung, the concave lower surface
extra.zh: 右肺底部，凹形的下面

extra.en: Rests on the dome of the diaphragm, which separates it from the liver; the right dome is higher than the left
extra.zh: 貼在橫膈穹窿上，隔著橫膈與肝相鄰；右側穹窿比左側高

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-331.name: Inferior border of right lung

extra.en: Lower edge of the right lung, between the diaphragmatic surface and the costal and mediastinal surfaces
extra.zh: 右肺下緣，位於膈面與肋面、縱隔面之間

extra.en: Reaches the 6th rib at the midclavicular line and the 8th rib at the midaxillary line
extra.zh: 在鎖骨中線處達第 6 肋，在腋中線處達第 8 肋

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-332.name: Apex of left lung

extra.en: Top of the left lung, rising above the first rib into the root of the neck
extra.zh: 左肺最上端，越過第 1 肋進入頸根

extra.en: Covered by the cervical pleura; the left subclavian artery grooves it from in front
extra.zh: 外覆胸膜頂；左鎖骨下動脈由前方壓出溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-333.name: Groove for first rib of left lung

extra.en: Near the apex of the left lung, on the side facing the first rib
extra.zh: 左肺肺尖附近，朝向第 1 肋的一側

extra.en: First rib
extra.zh: 第 1 肋

extra.en: The groove for the left subclavian artery lies on the mediastinal side of the apex
extra.zh: 左鎖骨下動脈溝在肺尖的縱隔側

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-334.name: Contact area for thymus of left lung

extra.en: Front part of the mediastinal surface of the left lung, above the cardiac impression
extra.zh: 左肺縱隔面前部，心壓跡上方

extra.en: Thymus (or its fatty remnant) in the anterior mediastinum
extra.zh: 前縱隔的胸腺（或其脂肪殘餘）

extra.en: Cardiac impression below; groove for the left brachiocephalic vein above and behind
extra.zh: 下方是心壓跡；後上方是左頭臂靜脈溝

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-335.name: Anterior border of left lung

extra.en: Front edge of the left lung, between the costal and mediastinal surfaces
extra.zh: 左肺前緣，位於肋面與縱隔面之間

extra.en: Thin and sharp; its lower part bends away to form the cardiac notch
extra.zh: 薄而銳；下部彎開形成心切跡

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-336.name: Diaphragmatic surface of left lung

extra.en: Base of the left lung, the concave lower surface
extra.zh: 左肺底部，凹形的下面

extra.en: Rests on the dome of the diaphragm, which separates it from the stomach and spleen
extra.zh: 貼在橫膈穹窿上，隔著橫膈與胃及脾相鄰

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-337.name: Inferior border of left lung

extra.en: Lower edge of the left lung, between the diaphragmatic surface and the costal and mediastinal surfaces
extra.zh: 左肺下緣，位於膈面與肋面、縱隔面之間

extra.en: Reaches the 6th rib at the midclavicular line and the 8th rib at the midaxillary line
extra.zh: 在鎖骨中線處達第 6 肋，在腋中線處達第 8 肋

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.), ch. 3 Thorax; Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-338.name: Right tendon of long head of biceps brachii
origin: Supraglenoid tubercle of the scapula and the glenoid labrum
肩胛骨盂上結節與關節盂唇
course: Arches over the head of the humerus inside the shoulder joint, then runs down the intertubercular groove under the transverse humeral ligament, wrapped in its synovial sheath
越過肱骨頭上方進入肩關節腔，再沿結節間溝下行，被橫肱韌帶蓋住，外包滑膜鞘

PK-438.name: Right tendon of sartorius
origin: Muscle belly of sartorius

course: A flat tendon that passes behind the medial femoral condyle, in front of the tendons of gracilis and semitendinosus, and spreads out on the medial side of the tibia
扁平的肌腱，經股骨內側髁後方，在股薄肌腱與半腱肌腱的前方，散開在脛骨內側

origin: Muscle belly of gracilis

course: A round cord that passes behind the medial femoral condyle, between the tendons of sartorius (in front) and semitendinosus (behind)
圓索狀，經股骨內側髁後方，位於縫匠肌腱（前）與半腱肌腱（後）之間

PK-446.name: Right tendon of popliteus

insertion: Medial and plantar surface of the medial cuneiform and the base of the first metatarsal

insertion: Tuberosity of the navicular, with slips to the cuneiforms, the cuboid, the bases of the second to fourth metatarsals and the sustentaculum tali
舟狀骨粗隆，並有分束到楔骨、骰骨、第二至第四蹠骨底與載距突
action: Inverts the foot and plantar flexes the ankle; the main dynamic support of the medial longitudinal arch

origin: Muscle belly of flexor digitorum longus
屈趾長肌的肌腹
course: Passes behind the medial malleolus in its own sheath, behind the tendon of tibialis posterior; in the sole it crosses the tendon of flexor hallucis longus (the knot of Henry), receives the quadratus plantae and divides into four tendons
在內踝後方、脛後肌腱的後面，包在專屬腱鞘內通過；到足底時與屈拇趾長肌腱交叉（亨利結），接受蹠方肌，再分成四條肌腱
insertion: Plantar surface of the bases of the distal phalanges of the second to fifth toes
第二至第五趾遠節趾骨底的蹠面
action: Flexes the toes, plantar flexes the ankle and supports the longitudinal arch
屈趾、使踝蹠屈，並支撐縱弓

PK-454.name: Right tendon of flexor hallucis longus
origin: Muscle belly of flexor hallucis longus
屈拇趾長肌的肌腹
course: The most posterior tendon of the tarsal tunnel: it passes in a groove on the back of the talus and under the sustentaculum tali, behind the posterior tibial vessels and the tibial nerve, then along the sole between the two heads of flexor hallucis brevis to the big toe

拇趾遠節趾骨底的蹠面

屈拇趾、使踝蹠屈，並在蹬地時用力

PK-456.name: Right tendon of extensor hallucis longus
origin: Muscle belly of extensor hallucis longus
伸拇趾長肌的肌腹
course: Passes between the tendons of tibialis anterior and extensor digitorum longus, under the extensor retinacula and over the dorsalis pedis artery, to the back of the big toe
在脛前肌腱與伸趾長肌腱之間，經伸肌支持帶深面，越過足背動脈，到拇趾背面
insertion: Dorsal surface of the base of the distal phalanx of the big toe
拇趾遠節趾骨底的背面

insertion: Extensor expansions of the second to fifth toes, ending on the middle and distal phalanges
第二至第五趾的伸肌擴張部，止於中節與遠節趾骨
action: Extends the four lateral toes and dorsiflexes the ankle
伸外側四趾並使踝背屈

PK-460.name: Right tendon of fibularis longus

腓長肌（腓骨長肌）的肌腹

insertion: Lateral side of the medial cuneiform and the base of the first metatarsal
內側楔骨的外側與第一蹠骨底
action: Everts the foot, plantar flexes the ankle and supports the transverse and lateral longitudinal arches
使足外翻、踝蹠屈，並支撐橫弓與外側縱弓

第五蹠骨底的粗隆

PK-465.name: Left tendon of fibularis tertius
origin: Muscle belly of fibularis tertius (part of extensor digitorum longus; absent in some people)
第三腓骨肌的肌腹（伸趾長肌的一部分；部分人缺如）

與伸趾長肌腱一起在其外側通過伸肌支持帶，到足外側緣
insertion: Dorsal surface of the base of the fifth metatarsal
第五蹠骨底的背面
action: Dorsiflexes the ankle and everts the foot
使踝背屈、足外翻
note: Cut from the muscle mesh: the muscle part ends where the tendon begins, and the two share the cut edge. Where the source mesh ran through a bone or stopped short of it, the tendon was lifted out of the bone or extended onto it.

PK-466.name: Right tendon of plantaris
origin: Small muscle belly of plantaris on the lateral supracondylar line of the femur
位於股骨外側髁上線的蹠肌小肌腹
course: A very long, thin tendon that runs obliquely between gastrocnemius and soleus and then along the medial border of the calcaneal tendon
極長而細的肌腱，斜行於腓腸肌與比目魚肌之間，再沿跟腱內側緣下行
insertion: Posterior part of the calcaneus, beside (or joined to) the calcaneal tendon
跟骨後部，在跟腱旁（或併入跟腱）
action: Weakly assists gastrocnemius in plantar flexing the ankle and flexing the knee
輕微協助腓腸肌使踝蹠屈、膝屈
note: Cut from the muscle mesh: the muscle part ends where the tendon begins, and the two share the cut edge. Where the source mesh ran through a bone or stopped short of it, the tendon was lifted out of the bone or extended onto it.

PK-468.name: Right superior extensor retinaculum of foot
origin: Anterior borders of the distal tibia and fibula
脛骨與腓骨遠端的前緣
course: A transverse band across the front of the lower leg, just above the ankle; the tendons of tibialis anterior, extensor hallucis longus and extensor digitorum longus, the anterior tibial vessels and the deep fibular nerve pass under it
橫跨小腿下部前方、踝上方的橫帶；脛前肌腱、伸拇趾長肌腱、伸趾長肌腱，以及脛前血管與腓深神經從它深面通過
supply: Holds the extensor tendons against the front of the leg so that they do not bowstring when the ankle dorsiflexes
把伸肌腱壓在小腿前方，使踝背屈時肌腱不會拱起
action: Holds the extensor tendons against the front of the leg so that they do not bowstring when the ankle dorsiflexes

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-469.name: Right inferior extensor retinaculum of foot
origin: Lateral side: upper surface of the calcaneus, in front of the sulcus calcanei (sinus tarsi)
外側：跟骨上面，跗骨竇（跟骨溝）的前方
course: A Y-shaped band over the front of the ankle and the dorsum of the foot: the single lateral root splits into an upper limb that ends on the medial malleolus and a lower limb that runs to the medial side of the foot; the extensor tendons run through its loops, the dorsalis pedis artery and the deep fibular nerve pass under it
Y 形的帶，位於踝前與足背：外側單一根部分成兩支，上支止於內踝，下支走向足內側；伸肌腱穿過它形成的環，足背動脈與腓深神經從它深面通過
supply: Keeps the extensor tendons of the foot in place on the dorsum of the ankle during dorsiflexion
在踝背屈時把足背的伸肌腱固定在原位
insertion: Medial malleolus (upper limb) and the plantar aponeurosis on the medial side of the foot (lower limb)
內踝（上支）與足內側的足底腱膜（下支）
action: Keeps the extensor tendons of the foot in place on the dorsum of the ankle during dorsiflexion

refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-470.name: Right plantar aponeurosis
origin: Medial process of the calcaneal tuberosity
跟骨粗隆的內側突
course: A thick fibrous sheet over the muscles of the sole that fans out towards the toes into five bands, one to each toe, and is continuous with the fibrous sheaths of the flexor tendons
覆在足底肌肉上的厚纖維膜，向趾端散開成五條帶，各到一趾，並與屈肌腱的纖維鞘相連
supply: Supports the longitudinal arch of the foot like a tie-beam and tightens when the toes are extended (windlass mechanism)
像拉桿般支撐足縱弓，趾伸直時繃緊（絞盤機制）
insertion: Fibrous sheaths of the flexor tendons and the bases of the proximal phalanges of the toes
屈肌腱的纖維鞘與各趾近節趾骨底
action: Supports the longitudinal arch of the foot like a tie-beam and tightens when the toes are extended (windlass mechanism)
像拉桿般支撐足縱弓，趾伸直時繃緊（絞盤機制）
note: The shape follows an open anatomical model of this structure, placed on the bones of this atlas; its attachments are anchored to the bones.
形狀依開放解剖模型的對應構造，並對位到本圖譜的骨骼；附著處固定在骨上。

origin: Medial border of the patella and the edge of the quadriceps tendon (from vastus medialis)
髕骨內側緣與股四頭肌腱邊緣（自股內側肌）
course: A thin layer that passes beside the patella to the medial tibial condyle and the medial epicondyle of the femur
薄層，走在髕骨內側，連到脛骨內側髁與股骨內上髁
supply: Holds the patella in the trochlear groove and resists lateral displacement of the patella
把髕骨固定在滑車溝內，抵抗髕骨向外側脫位
insertion: Medial condyle of the tibia
脛骨內側髁
action: Holds the patella in the trochlear groove and resists lateral displacement of the patella
把髕骨固定在滑車溝內，抵抗髕骨向外側脫位
note: The shape follows an open anatomical model of this structure, placed on the bones of this atlas; its attachments are anchored to the bones.

髕骨外側緣與股四頭肌腱邊緣（自股外側肌）；由髂脛束加強
course: A thin layer that passes beside the patella to the lateral tibial condyle and the lateral epicondyle of the femur
薄層，走在髕骨外側，連到脛骨外側髁與股骨外上髁
supply: Holds the patella in the trochlear groove and resists medial displacement of the patella
把髕骨固定在滑車溝內，抵抗髕骨向內側脫位
insertion: Lateral condyle of the tibia
脛骨外側髁
action: Holds the patella in the trochlear groove and resists medial displacement of the patella
把髕骨固定在滑車溝內，抵抗髕骨向內側脫位
note: The shape follows an open anatomical model of this structure, placed on the bones of this atlas; its attachments are anchored to the bones.

PK-478.name: Right anterior talofibular ligament
origin: Anterior margin of the lateral malleolus
外踝前緣
course: A flat band that runs forwards and slightly medially, almost horizontally, across the front of the ankle joint capsule
扁平的帶，向前並稍向內側幾乎水平走行，橫過踝關節囊的前方
supply: Resists forward displacement of the talus and inversion of the plantar-flexed foot; it is the ligament torn most often in an ankle sprain
抵抗距骨向前移位與蹠屈足的內翻；是踝關節扭傷最常撕裂的韌帶
insertion: Lateral surface of the neck of the talus, in front of the fibular facet
距骨頸的外側面，位於腓骨關節面的前方
action: Resists forward displacement of the talus and inversion of the plantar-flexed foot; it is the ligament torn most often in an ankle sprain
抵抗距骨向前移位與蹠屈足的內翻；是踝關節扭傷最常撕裂的韌帶
note: Schematic band or cord between measured bony attachment points; width and thickness are typical values.
示意帶或索：兩端落在實測的骨性附著點，寬度與厚度為典型值。
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.

PK-479.name: Right posterior talofibular ligament
origin: Malleolar fossa on the medial side of the lateral malleolus
外踝內側的外踝窩
course: A strong band that runs medially and slightly backwards, almost horizontally, behind the ankle joint
強韌的帶，向內側並稍向後、近乎水平地走在踝關節後方
supply: Resists backward displacement of the talus and extreme dorsiflexion; the strongest of the three lateral ligaments and rarely torn on its own
抵抗距骨向後移位與過度背屈；是三條外側韌帶中最強的，很少單獨撕裂
insertion: Lateral tubercle of the posterior process of the talus
距骨後突的外側結節
action: Resists backward displacement of the talus and extreme dorsiflexion; the strongest of the three lateral ligaments and rarely torn on its own

PK-480.name: Right calcaneofibular ligament

外踝尖（前部）
course: A round cord that runs downwards and backwards, deep to the tendons of fibularis longus and brevis, across both the ankle and the subtalar joint

抵抗背屈足的內翻，並穩定距下關節
insertion: Lateral surface of the calcaneus, behind the fibular trochlea
跟骨外側面，位於腓骨滑車後方
action: Resists inversion of the dorsiflexed foot and stabilises the subtalar joint

PK-481.name: Right anterior tibiotalar ligament

內踝前丘
course: A short flat band that runs forwards and downwards on the medial side of the ankle, deep to the other parts of the deltoid ligament
短而扁的帶，在踝內側向前下走行，位於三角韌帶其他部分的深面
supply: The anterior deep part of the deltoid ligament: resists eversion and forward displacement of the talus
三角韌帶的前深部：抵抗足外翻與距骨向前移位
insertion: Medial surface of the talus, near its neck
距骨內側面，靠近頸部
action: The anterior deep part of the deltoid ligament: resists eversion and forward displacement of the talus
三角韌帶的前深部：抵抗足外翻與距骨向前移位
note: Schematic band or cord between measured bony attachment points; width and thickness are typical values.

PK-482.name: Right plantar calcaneonavicular ligament
PK-482.zh: 右跟舟足底韌帶（彈簧韌帶）

跟骨載距突的前緣
course: A broad, thick band that runs forwards under the head of the talus, which rests on it; the tendon of tibialis posterior runs beneath it

course: A thin fibrous expansion (the “goose foot”) in which the three tendons end side by side, from front to back sartorius, gracilis and semitendinosus; the pes anserine bursa lies between it and the tibial collateral ligament
薄的纖維擴張部（「鵝掌」），三條肌腱並排止於其中，由前向後為縫匠肌、股薄肌、半腱肌；它與脛側副韌帶之間有鵝足滑液囊
supply: Flexes the knee, rotates the flexed leg medially and resists valgus (abduction) stress on the knee
屈膝、使屈曲的小腿內旋，並抵抗膝的外翻外力
insertion: Upper part of the medial surface of the tibia, below the tibial tuberosity level of the medial condyle
脛骨內側面上部，位於內側髁下方
action: Flexes the knee, rotates the flexed leg medially and resists valgus (abduction) stress on the knee
屈膝、使屈曲的小腿內旋，並抵抗膝的外翻外力
note: Schematic band or cord between measured bony attachment points; width and thickness are typical values.
示意帶或索：兩端落在實測的骨性附著點，寬度與厚度為典型值。
refs: Gray’s Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake et al.); Moore’s Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.
